name: Fran Hong
subject: Introducing Firewall
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Francesca Hong
body:
New policy to protect your rights in an AI world
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260612-2908)
Peter,
AI data centers are in the headlines, but corporations, police, and health insurance companies are already using algorithms and AI technology to shape your life.
We can’t turn back the clock on computer science, but we can pass the laws all of us need to protect our civil and consumer rights in the face of advanced technology.
Introducing [FIREWALL](https://act.francescahong.com/go/13903?t=1&akid=2908%2E105371%2EAjMlYZ), a four-part plan to protect Wisconsin from the unchecked use of artificial intelligence.
[](https://act.francescahong.com/go/13903?t=2&akid=2908%2E105371%2EAjMlYZ)
Technology should make people’s lives safer, easier, and more affordable. But without rules and accountability, we’re giving powerful people new ways to exploit working people. As governor, I’ll make sure Wisconsin writes the rules before Big Tech and corporate lobbyists write them for us.
Here's what's in our plan:
* **REMOVE FROM CART** — Bans personalized "desperation" surveillance pricing across Wisconsin's economy, permanently prohibits algorithmic rent collusion, and requires a human being to justify any healthcare claim denial.
* **INCOGNITO MODE** — Extends HIPAA-level protection to all your health data, whether it's held by a hospital, a chatbot, an app, or your smartwatch.
* **BATTLE BOTS** — Requires clear labels on AI-generated content, and requires chatbots to identify themselves as AI and refer people in crisis to real help.
* **PRIME DIRECTIVE** — Bans the highest-risk police surveillance AI, including live facial recognition in public spaces and camera networks like Flock, and requires any algorithm used in a Wisconsin prosecution to be disclosed to the defense.

Other states are already moving on this, and we can be part of the vanguard: Maryland just enacted the nation's first ban on surveillance pricing in grocery stores. Washington State extended health data privacy beyond HIPAA. California's companion chatbot safety law took effect in January
Together with [CONTROL-ALT-DELETE](https://act.francescahong.com/go/13904?t=3&akid=2908%2E105371%2EAjMlYZ) (our data center plan) and [LABOR SHIFT](https://act.francescahong.com/go/11777?t=4&akid=2908%2E105371%2EAjMlYZ) (our workers' rights plan), [FIREWALL](https://act.francescahong.com/go/13903?t=5&akid=2908%2E105371%2EAjMlYZ) makes our AI platform the most comprehensive of any candidate in this race.
The companies profiting from these algorithms have lobbyists, lawyers, and billions of dollars. We have a plan to fight back — and we have you.
**[Chip in today to help us put FIREWALL in front of every Wisconsin voter before the August 11 primary.](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260612.kFZz5I&refcode=em20260612-2908&t=6&akid=2908%2E105371%2EAjMlYZ)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260612.kFZz5I&amount=5&refcode=em20260612-2908&t=9&akid=2908%2E105371%2EAjMlYZ)**
In solidarity,
Fran

INCOGNITO MODE — Extends HIPAA-level protection to all your health data, whether it's held by a hospital, a chatbot, an app, or your smartwatch. BATTLE BOTS — Requires clear labels on AI-generated content, and requires chatbots to identify themselves as AI and refer people in crisis to real help. PRIME DIRECTIVE — Bans the highest-risk police surveillance AI, including live facial recognition in public spaces and camera networks like Flock, and requires any algorithm used in a Wisconsin prosecution to be disclosed to the defense. Other states are already moving on this, and we can be part of the vanguard: Maryland just enacted the nation's first ban on surveillance pricing in grocery stores. Washington State extended health data privacy beyond HIPAA. California's companion chatbot safety law took effect in January Together with (our data center plan) and (our workers' rights plan), makes our AI platform the most comprehensive of any candidate in this race. The companies profiting from these algorithms have lobbyists, lawyers, and billions of dollars. We have a plan to fight back — and we have you. In solidarity, Fran Email us: mailto:info@francescahong.com

Growing up I never imagined this future was possible.
| | | Folks, Chris Pappas here. **Happy Pride!** 🏳️🌈

So much has changed since I was a kid. I remember hearing so much derogatory language used against gay people – some directed at me before I even knew who I was.

When I came out in college, I was lucky to have a family that supported me unconditionally. More and more Granite Staters ascribe to a live‐and‐let‐live philosophy. They want their neighbors to be able to live freely and be who they are. That's why **New Hampshire was one of the first states to support marriage equality.**

But the Trump Administration has been relentlessly attacking the LGBTQ+ community – taking away vital mental health resources and supporting discriminatory laws. I'm running for Senate to represent all Granite Staters — and while, if elected, I would be the first out gay man in the Senate, this campaign is about fighting for everyone.

November feels far away. It isn't. |
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133196539/627052810/-1614139448?Refcode=260608-email-dcs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzEzNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMzVmOGY0Mi02YjY2LWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Fqj0pQR-097yMBEEjRs2vdnRPT_vDq59Yqzhl_qe3cw=)

Team, November feels far away. **It isn't.** This is the season campaigns are built. Not in October when ads are running and everyone's paying attention, **but right now** , in the quiet months when staff gets hired, doors get knocked for the first time, and the infrastructure that actually wins elections either gets built or doesn't. Republicans know this. They're building right now, and they’re counting on us to fall behind while they pull ahead. That's why I'm asking you to do something different today: don't just invest once. **Consider becoming a monthly donor to the Tennessee Democratic Party.** **When you give monthly, we can plan. We can hire. We can move fast when it counts.** Recurring support means we can build steadily instead of scrambling when it's almost too late. The work happening now in June, July, and August is what makes us competitive in November. * * *
# **Elon Musk Becomes World 's First Trillionaire as SpaceX Goes Public**
SpaceX raised a record **[$75 billion in its IPO Thursday,](https://substack.com/redirect/7a16c1c6-fe1e-4a06-bc42-a8bae3314428?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** vaulting Elon Musk's net worth past $1.1 trillion and making him the world's first trillionaire. Musk's SpaceX stake alone is valued at roughly $866 billion -- nearly three times the net worth of the second-wealthiest person on the planet. Investors are wagering that Musk can replicate Tesla's transformative impact in the space and artificial intelligence industries, though SpaceX remains cash-intensive and relies on technologies that may take years to become commercially viable.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7a16c1c6-fe1e-4a06-bc42-a8bae3314428?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Musk 's rise has reshaped how markets value companies.** Analysts describe the phenomenon as the "Elon premium" -- valuations driven more by faith in Musk's vision than conventional financial metrics. His empire, sometimes called the "Muskonomy," spans Tesla, SpaceX, X (formerly Twitter), Neuralink, and The Boring Company, among others.
* **The milestone arrives amid ongoing controversy.** Musk's involvement in the Trump administration's DOGE initiative damaged Tesla's international sales and sparked consumer boycotts in 2025. His public falling-out with President Trump and recent reconciliation raised questions about the entanglement of his business interests and political ambitions.

* * *
# **Gas prices fall for third straight week but uncertainty persists**
The national average for a gallon of regular **[gas dropped to $4.108 Friday,](https://substack.com/redirect/1586c338-d635-4071-bf8b-c46d97f13ef9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** continuing a three-week decline that followed a 2026 peak of $4.564 on May 21. Prices are now roughly 40 cents cheaper than a month ago, offering some relief to drivers after months of volatility tied directly to the US-Iran conflict and tensions in the Strait of Hormuz.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1586c338-d635-4071-bf8b-c46d97f13ef9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Analysts warn the relief may not last.** GasBuddy price analyst Patrick De Haan **[told the Washington Examiner](https://substack.com/redirect/1586c338-d635-4071-bf8b-c46d97f13ef9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that summer gas prices could swing anywhere from below $4 to above $5 per gallon. He noted that while markets have grown somewhat accustomed to war-related disruptions after 100 days of conflict, unpredictable developments could still trigger sharp swings.
* **Regional price gaps remain stark.** Indiana currently has the nation's cheapest gas at roughly $3.38 per gallon, while California leads all states at $5.79, followed by Hawaii and Washington.

* * *
# **Threats and Violence Follow Karmelo Anthony Murder Conviction**
Following Karmelo Anthony's murder conviction and 35-year sentence for the 2025 stabbing death of Austin Metcalf, some supporters have allegedly **[turned to violence and intimidation.](https://substack.com/redirect/0f84b368-7c1c-4ee8-88cd-d956058cdffc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[| | | | | New York Post
---
@nypost

| 1:13 PM * Jun 11, 2026 * 35.5K Views154 Replies * 170 Reposts * 701 Likes
---](https://substack.com/redirect/d041c217-b202-40dc-8685-a1772e7bea44?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Austin Metcalf 's family has been inundated with threatening messages** since Karmelo Anthony was convicted of murder and sentenced to 35 years in prison Tuesday. The harassment, which began after Anthony's arrest last April, intensified sharply following the verdict. Messages were sent directly to family members' personal phones, with one explicitly stating that Austin's twin brother Hunter should have also been stabbed. Supporters have allegedly threatened to appear at the family's home and desecrate Austin's grave. Austin's father Jeff Metcalf has publicly confirmed he is still receiving death threats.
* **A new GoFundMe campaign raising money for Anthony 's legal defense was swiftly removed** Thursday after collecting $726. GoFundMe cited its longstanding policy prohibiting fundraisers benefiting individuals formally charged with violent crimes.
* **Anthony, now 19, has been transferred to a Texas state prison** to begin serving his sentence. He has filed a notice of appeal challenging the conviction and could potentially be released in as few as 17 years.

| | | | [](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkT2O3DAMhU9DdzOQKFv2FC6SOA5SbIA0m9LQShxZgPUDSfZcP_Bi5gDbke89fATJf2_Lm3KbC_aP8jTqwy25LGUltflY6oNCrWuOu10frq5uQYbywuSF45njjRm1kQIbGnk_cOwl512zjowYN8MgWib0cCPDb6Ilut-I7v39xqhx40likiNvu47jVX90JHhLZO7UyoGgZXsyqlK56hgK5UNVd5ALIZ5VDFcdfbONa62pgPgGOAPO1h10TZk-Yv4MAM7PDnBWKZHaCoi5aBDTz1-Mo5y_A0rlK4ipk4DSFhCTMoByr34pcc-aQEwpx5JIVxfs0_Jk3O5BTOSV256iVj4pZ8MpH5RtJgoLDi83hkrhHPWOy9_-8uP99-V1hiaPJj3ctrkie2iZPamfO9avf-UY8X8AAAD__1pcm3M)

Advocate for Life, The abortion pill was already sitting in her online cart when she found PreBorn!. She had spent most of the night scrolling through websites that promised an easy solution to her fear. Everything she read made the process sound clinical, detached, and uncomplicated—as though ending a pregnancy was no more significant than filling a prescription. But underneath the panic and late-night searching was a woman who felt completely trapped. She wasn’t thinking about politics. She was thinking about rent. About disappointing her parents. About whether the father would disappear if she kept the baby. About how alone she felt carrying a secret she didn’t know how to tell anyone. And like so many women today, she was being pushed toward abortion before anyone had even shown her her baby. [**That is why PreBorn!’s ministry is so urgent right now.**](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkT2O3DAMhU9DdzOQKFv2FC6SOA5SbIA0m9LQShxZgPUDSfZcP_Bi5gDbke89fATJf2_Lm3KbC_aP8jTqwy25LGUltflY6oNCrWuOu10frq5uQYbywuSF45njjRm1kQIbGnk_cOwl512zjowYN8MgWib0cCPDb6Ilut-I7v39xqhx40likiNvu47jVX90JHhLZO7UyoGgZXsyqlK56hgK5UNVd5ALIZ5VDFcdfbONa62pgPgGOAPO1h10TZk-Yv4MAM7PDnBWKZHaCoi5aBDTz1-Mo5y_A0rlK4ipk4DSFhCTMoByr34pcc-aQEwpx5JIVxfs0_Jk3O5BTOSV256iVj4pZ8MpH5RtJgoLDi83hkrhHPWOy9_-8uP99-V1hiaPJj3ctrkie2iZPamfO9avf-UY8X8AAAD__1pcm3M) More abortions than ever are happening through pills ordered quickly and privately, often without an ultrasound and without meaningful counseling. The entire system is built around speed. Move fast. Don’t think too long. Solve the problem before the emotions catch up. At PreBorn!, we step into the middle of that rush and offer something radically different. We offer her a chance to pause. A chance to ask questions.
A chance to be heard.
A chance to see the child growing inside her through a free ultrasound funded by people like you. And when she sees her baby, everything changes. The fear that pushed her toward abortion begins to loosen its grip. The decision suddenly carries weight and humanity in a way she hadn’t allowed herself to consider before. [**More than 80% of mothers who receive a PreBorn! ultrasound choose life.**](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkT2O3DAMhU9DdzOQKFv2FC6SOA5SbIA0m9LQShxZgPUDSfZcP_Bi5gDbke89fATJf2_Lm3KbC_aP8jTqwy25LGUltflY6oNCrWuOu10frq5uQYbywuSF45njjRm1kQIbGnk_cOwl512zjowYN8MgWib0cCPDb6Ilut-I7v39xqhx40likiNvu47jVX90JHhLZO7UyoGgZXsyqlK56hgK5UNVd5ALIZ5VDFcdfbONa62pgPgGOAPO1h10TZk-Yv4MAM7PDnBWKZHaCoi5aBDTz1-Mo5y_A0rlK4ipk4DSFhCTMoByr34pcc-aQEwpx5JIVxfs0_Jk3O5BTOSV256iVj4pZ8MpH5RtJgoLDi83hkrhHPWOy9_-8uP99-V1hiaPJj3ctrkie2iZPamfO9avf-UY8X8AAAD__1pcm3M) Your $28 gift creates that moment. It places a mother in front of truth before fear makes the decision for her. It opens the door for compassionate care, practical support, and the hope of the gospel at a moment when many women feel completely abandoned. Will you help another woman see her baby before it’s too late?

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP62/1/120031/images/eon%20header.png]
Team, over the last few months, I've had some time to think.
And the more I thought, the more I kept coming back to something my father used to say at the dinner table when I was growing up in Peoria.
He'd look at us and say: "Think of the greatness of this country. Whatever you do, make sure this country is there for the next families who need it."
He said that as an immigrant who came here with nothing. He said it after our family had struggled, having lived in public housing and on food stamps. He said it because he believed — with everything he had — that this country could still be a place where hard work leads somewhere. Where a kid with a hard-to-pronounce last name still gets a real shot.
I built my entire life around that belief.
And right now, that belief is under direct attack.
Donald Trump and his MAGA allies are gutting the safety net that kept my family afloat.
They're rigging the economy for billionaires while working and middle-class families fall further behind.
They're weaponizing the government against immigrants, against workers, against anyone who dares to believe the American Dream should be available to everyone — not just the powerful and well-connected.
My father's America is being dismantled piece by piece. And I refuse to sit back and watch it happen.
That's why today, I'm launching Equal Opportunity Now — a group dedicated to supporting causes and leaders who will fight like hell to expand opportunity, take on Trump's MAGA agenda, and make sure this country is still there for the next families that need it.
Equal Opportunity Now will support the fights that matter most to working families: making sure every child has food on the table and access to a quality education, lowering prescription drug costs and grocery prices, strengthening good-paying jobs and workers' rights, holding corporate bad actors and corrupt politicians accountable, and fighting bigotry and prejudice in all its forms.
These problems require ambitious, bold solutions, championed by leaders who know that our time is running out.
That's why I need you to become a founding donor of Equal Opportunity Now today.
The leaders and groups who are willing to fight back against Trump's MAGA agenda and deliver real change are out there. But they need funding, infrastructure, and people ready to invest in them early. Founding donors who step up now make it possible. They make it real.
Will you split a contribution of $10, $25, or $50 with Equal Opportunity now and Resist Reclaim Rebuild to start this organization off on the right foot? Your grassroots contribution in this early stage will be CRUCIAL to helping us win. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-eon]
CHIP IN TODAY TO DEFEAT MAGA EXTREMISM! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-eon]
My father was right about this country. It's worth fighting for.
Thanks for joining me in the next chapter of my journey; it means the world to me.
— Raja Krishnamoorthi

Friend,
Jewish Americans are being targeted, attacked, and killed simply because of who they are. This alarming trend demands comprehensive action that addresses both the seeds and the impacts of this vile hatred.
**That's why I just introduced the _Jewish American Security Act_ _ _ to combat antisemitism at schools, in communal institutions, and online. **
As the third Jewish woman and first former synagogue president ever elected to the Senate, the fight against antisemitism is personal for me.
When I was just a few years old, I was playing in a hotel swimming pool with my mom. A lifeguard told her that we were “dirty” because we were Jewish, and we had to leave the pool immediately. We never forgot that interaction.
Most Jewish Americans have experienced antisemitism like this firsthand. But recently, such bigotry has manifested into dangerous violence. **Last year, we saw a record number of**** _physical assaults_ and attacks with _deadly weapons_ against Jews.**
My bipartisan legislation aims to make our Jewish communities safer by making $1 billion in security investments for houses of worship and other nonprofit institutions. It will also mandate a new federal framework to combat antisemitism on college campuses. And it will require social media sites to demonstrate how they handle antisemitic content on their platforms.
**But there is so much more work left to do to protect Jews from the scourge of antisemitic violence. It’s work that requires dedication, steady leadership, and long-term commitment. That’s why I'm counting on _your_ support today – not for a single moment or a single fight – but for the long road ahead. Let’s build the kind of campaign that can be a strong, courageous voice for people when it matters most.**

name: Brandy Byrd
body:
Good Morning Everyone !!!

Notes from the field!!

We have some upcoming and ongoing volunteer activities.

**Georgetown, TX**
**
**
** _June 13, 2026_**

**The immediate need is the Juneteenth Festival on June 13, 2026 from 10:15am to 4pm**. We are meeting at the Georgetown Community Center where at 10:15am we form up for the walking parade. This is a short walk. Afterwards there will be a quick speech about Juneteenth. After the parade we will go man a booth where we will be handing out campaign literature, yard signs, and asking for a donation for those that want t-shirts. Now, if you have never been to a Juneteenth Festival this is a great time to take part in one. I would highly recommend this event 10 out of 10 and this is the first one of the season!!! It will be fun!! Don’t stay home this weekend.

**Data-Entry!! Data-Entry!! Data-Entry!! Data-Entry!!**

We need Data-Entry personel! We have a large amount of information that we need entered in. It is so much information that it will be a turning point for the campaign. Everyone please sign up for data-entry. We would greatly appreciate it. If you know of any youth that would like to get some volunteer hours or not doing anything this summer and they know how to type please have them sign up. EVERYONE SHOULD SIGN UP! I know I am.

There’s no sugarcoating it: Donald Trump fired all 22 members of the National Science Board.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?refcode=260612-fires-rs [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?refcode=260612-fires-rs]
FIGHT BACK [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?refcode=260612-fires-rs]
This is the governing body overseeing the National Science Foundation, one of the most important scientific institutions in the United States — and he fired all of them. At once.
The National Science Board exists for a reason. It oversees billions in federal research funding, advises Congress on science policy, and helps ensure taxpayer dollars support real, evidence-based innovation.
Now that independence is being stripped away.
Let me say this clearly: When political leaders start dismantling independent science institutions, it doesn’t just hurt scientists. It hurts all of us — because that means fewer medical breakthroughs, less climate research, slower progress on cancer treatments, degraded pandemic preparedness, and more.
As a microbiologist and educator, take it from me: Science only works when it is allowed to be independent, transparent, and guided by evidence — not politics.
But what we’re seeing now is a systematic effort to replace expertise with loyalty, and it’s happening at the highest levels of government.
This is exactly why I’m running for Congress. Because we need leaders who will defend science and protect vital institutions like the NSF.
But I can’t take on that fight alone. We’re heading into a critical stretch of this campaign, and we need the resources to compete against entrenched interests that are perfectly comfortable ignoring science. So I’m asking you: Can you chip in $10 or whatever you can today to help me fight for science, facts, and the future of research in America? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?refcode=260612-fires-rs]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?refcode=260612-fires-rs]
When we let science lead, people thrive. Let’s put facts back in charge — and build a Congress that reflects reason, reality, and hope.
Thank you,
Dr. Jasmine Clark
Democratic Candidate for Georgia's 13th District

59 years ago today, the Supreme Court made a landmark decision in _Loving v. Virginia_ \- striking down laws banning interracial marriage and paving the way for countless civil rights advancements.

As the daughter of an African-American father and a Korean mother, this decision made my family’s story possible, just as it did for millions of other interracial families across our country.

**But nearly six decades later, our most fundamental rights are under attack.**

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/45a8a4cf-0948-4539-a846-697b12eeb6fe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Padilla refused to answer our questions about mail-in voting because he didn't have a good answer. Padilla and his Democrat allies knew exactly what they were doing to hold back a popular mayoral candidate fueled by discontent with generations of Democrat rules in the City of Angels. According to online betting platform Kalshi, Spencer Pratt had a 70 percent [chance ](https://substack.com/redirect/ac16ec58-abb2-4883-98da-f6bb75c474b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)of advancing to the Los Angeles mayoral runoff election at midnight ET on June 3rd, just hours after the polls closed.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b70e4e75-8f24-410e-954c-ff88e8f1cb9d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Then a massive influx of mail-in ballots favoring socialist Nithya Raman flooded ballot-counting locations. According to local California media, Raman [received ](https://substack.com/redirect/e2ce1a0b-81f5-46f4-b6c4-b24fa6bf602b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)more than 19,000 votes via mail-in ballots since the polls closed on Tuesday. That is more than any other candidate in the Los Angeles mayoral race.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8cfd99fe-a842-408d-ac1b-37fc8d7a004a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Now, Angelenos are stuck with die-hard Kamala Harris-Joe Biden supporter Karen Bass facing off against socialist Nithya Raman. Democrats win no matter what and hold back a resurgent Spencer Pratt.
California Democrats like Senator Padilla and Governor Gavin Newsom have been pushing mail-in voting throughout 2026. In January, Padilla posted to his X account:
> _" Despite Trump and Republicans' baseless attacks, vote-by-mail remains one of the most effective and secure ways to make sure every eligible citizen can make their voice heard -- especially for servicemembers, rural voters, and Americans living overseas... That's why we're urging the Court to reject this blatant interference with California and other states' election laws that protect Americans' fundamental right to vote."_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7906b187-ad13-40d3-8f1f-291b060f0644?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

> _" Trump is going after vote-by-mail. Let's talk about it."_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7e0fff45-2f9a-442b-b701-d132ff9a99ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

body:

Peter, I need to be honest with you about what’s at stake at the end of this month. Let me explain.

body:
This cannot be allowed to keep happening | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133207189/627082763/-1977837920?refcode=06.12_SCPD_Statement&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODg3MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYmU1NjRkZS03NTY2LWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bOjFaPLtjg-_icneDIW2VF0etKYOD-DTstBv8qTrbmE=&emci=1559f6c0-6666-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&emdi=ebe564de-7566-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&ceid=53531271)

Friend, As you might know, I currently serve Shelby County as the Chief Public Defender. **Last week, _my office lost a client._** **__****Coltral’s death is a tragedy.** But it is also a symptom of a deeply broken status quo—one that treats human beings as statistics and locks people up simply because they are poor. **Last year alone,_13 human beings died in that same jail._** His exact cause of death has _not yet been determined_ —but Coltral’s death is a _tragedy_ , _**no matter the cause.**_ I didn't run for Governor to accept these failures, or to offer empty thoughts and prayers. I am running to bring real competence, accountability, and structural change to Tennessee. **When I am Governor, we are going to fix this system from the ground up:**
* **Close Every CoreCivic Facility:** Profit has absolutely no place in our justice system. Private, for-profit prisons incentivize putting more people behind bars while cutting corners on safety, healthcare, and staffing. We will end corporate-run incarceration in Tennessee.
* **Keep Foster Youth Out of Jails:** It is a moral failure that our state locks up foster children simply because we refuse to invest in their transition, mental health support, and stable housing. We must fund our youth, not criminalize them.
* **Legalize Marijuana & End Mass Incarceration for Nonviolent Offenses:** We waste millions of taxpayer dollars locking people up for nonviolent offenses. By legalizing marijuana, we can stop ruining lives over a plant, redirect law enforcement resources to violent crime, and invest new tax revenue back into our communities.
* **Challenge Unconstitutional Cash Bail:** Under our Constitution, every person is presumed innocent until proven guilty. We must challenge the unconstitutional laws and practices that allow people to lose their jobs, their housing, and sometimes their lives just because they can't afford to pay for their freedom.

**_True public safety_ and basic human dignity are not opposing forces**—they rely on one another. We can protect our communities while ensuring that our justice system operates with transparency, safety, and respect for human life. We are building a campaign across Tennessee to prove that leadership can be better than this. But to take this fight all the way to the Governor's mansion and defeat the special interests profiting off this broken system, I need you standing with me. _**[If you believe Tennessee deserves leadership rooted in accountability and dignity, please make a contribution of $10, $25, or whatever you can afford today to fuel this campaign.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133207190/627082764/1843264678?refcode=06.12_SCPD_Statement&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODg3MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYmU1NjRkZS03NTY2LWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bOjFaPLtjg-_icneDIW2VF0etKYOD-DTstBv8qTrbmE=)**_ | | [FUEL OUR FIGHT](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133207191/627082765/-843357993?refcode=06.12_SCPD_Statement&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODg3MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYmU1NjRkZS03NTY2LWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bOjFaPLtjg-_icneDIW2VF0etKYOD-DTstBv8qTrbmE=)

_**Thank you**_ for _standing with me,_ and for _refusing_ to let our neighbors be reduced to statistics.
With determination,
**Jerri Green**
Democratic Candidate For Tennessee Governor

clean_body: This cannot be allowed to keep happening | Friend, As you might know, I currently serve Shelby County as the Chief Public Defender. Last week, my office lost a client. Coltral’s death is a tragedy. But it is also a symptom of a deeply broken status quo—one that treats human beings as statistics and locks people up simply because they are poor. Last year alone,13 human beings died in that same jail. His exact cause of death has not yet been determined —but Coltral’s death is a tragedy , no matter the cause. I didn't run for Governor to accept these failures, or to offer empty thoughts and prayers. I am running to bring real competence, accountability, and structural change to Tennessee. When I am Governor, we are going to fix this system from the ground up: Close Every CoreCivic Facility: Profit has absolutely no place in our justice system. Private, for-profit prisons incentivize putting more people behind bars while cutting corners on safety, healthcare, and staffing. We will end corporate-run incarceration in Tennessee. Keep Foster Youth Out of Jails: It is a moral failure that our state locks up foster children simply because we refuse to invest in their transition, mental health support, and stable housing. We must fund our youth, not criminalize them. Legalize Marijuana & End Mass Incarceration for Nonviolent Offenses: We waste millions of taxpayer dollars locking people up for nonviolent offenses. By legalizing marijuana, we can stop ruining lives over a plant, redirect law enforcement resources to violent crime, and invest new tax revenue back into our communities. Challenge Unconstitutional Cash Bail: Under our Constitution, every person is presumed innocent until proven guilty. We must challenge the unconstitutional laws and practices that allow people to lose their jobs, their housing, and sometimes their lives just because they can't afford to pay for their freedom. True public safety and basic human dignity are not opposing forces—they rely on one another. We can protect our communities while ensuring that our justice system operates with transparency, safety, and respect for human life. We are building a campaign across Tennessee to prove that leadership can be better than this. But to take this fight all the way to the Governor's mansion and defeat the special interests profiting off this broken system, I need you standing with me. = | | = Thank you for standing with me, and for refusing to let our neighbors be reduced to statistics. With determination, Jerri Green Democratic Candidate For Tennessee Governor = Green For Governor P.O. # [What keeps you up at night?](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=201460332&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjAxNDYwMzMyLCJpYXQiOjE3ODEyODA0NjYsImV4cCI6MTc4Mzg3MjQ2NiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.QZMODcVGtO9TXlriXvVggFoEyCi8mI5_0HUAJ5tRprc)
### I want to know what you think.
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)

| Jun 12
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)

---
| | | [](https://substack..aqFs6zr6jqN4nvFa7y7Buoca-2WwjVIPmnUcCrX1ArI?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/what-keeps-you-up-at-night-c82?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

Hi friends,
I love talking to people, especially Michiganders. I crack open a pop and chat until the cows come home.
But here's a little secret to being an effective politician: _Stop talking._
Truly. Michiganders know what Michigan needs better than anyone. I learned a long time ago that the first step to getting stuff done is always the same: **Listen.**
That's why I'm reaching out with a simple request: **[Will you take one minute to fill out my 2026 Priorities Survey? We're collecting 1,000 responses before midnight tomorrow, and I'd be honored to hear from you directly.](https://substack.com/redirect/58815b90-249f-4f5c-a65b-15f0f3e50106?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Take the survey](https://substack.com/redirect/58815b90-249f-4f5c-a65b-15f0f3e50106?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**Here 's why it matters:**
This is shaping up to be one of the most competitive Senate races in the country. Poll after poll shows I'm leading against MAGA Republican Mike Rogers, and The New York Times even named Michigan a key battleground in the fight for Senate control.
The stakes are high. That's why GOP billionaire megadonors are lining up behind Rogers, trying to buy this seat so they can rubber-stamp Trump's chaos agenda in the Senate.
So how do we fight back? **By building a grassroots campaign that listens, learns, and leads - in that order.**
We've already made so much progress:
✅ I introduced the **Stop Trump 's Abuse of Power Act** after Donald Trump abused his power and deployed the military against U.S. citizens.
✅ I led the charge to bring **semiconductor manufacturing back** to Michigan, creating good-paying jobs for our communities.
✅ I introduced the **No Tariffs on Groceries Act** to stop Trump's chaotic price hikes at the checkout line.
✅ I filed articles of impeachment against **RFK Jr.** for putting public health at risk and lying to Congress.
I'm proud of this work. Because it all came from listening to the _real_ concerns of _real_ people - and then taking action to fight for them.
So as we build a winning strategy for what will be a generation-defining election in Michigan, I want to make sure this campaign reflects _your_ priorities.
What's keeping you up at night? What change do you want to see? What matters most to you and your family? How can the government actually help you?
**[Will you please take a minute and let me know? It's a short survey, but it truly helps a ton.](https://substack.com/redirect/58815b90-249f-4f5c-a65b-15f0f3e50106?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Take the survey](https://substack.com/redirect/58815b90-249f-4f5c-a65b-15f0f3e50106?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
This is your campaign just as much as it's mine. And together, we're going to make history.
I'm so glad you're here.
With grit and gratitude,
Haley
* * *

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?

## Can Republicans keep the Senate?
The media likes to push the narrative that Democrats are poised to flip the Senate in the midterms.
If you listen to their side, it seems like Democrat victory is all but decided.
Really?
Did they take math?
They make it sound almost inevitable.
But if you actually look at the map and do the basic math, the picture is very different.
Republicans are in a strong position. . . if we stay focused and disciplined.
Let's get into the reality of the Senate balance--not the narrative the Left is trying to push...

These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them.

They're already claimed. And we don't have extras.

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing.

Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. **

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet.

clean_body: A quick look at what’s happening right now I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground. | | | | | Peter, I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground. Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible. Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them. They're already claimed. And we don't have extras. By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in. Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it. That's where things stand right now. We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment. And I don't say that lightly. Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down. The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great. And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing. Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back. We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there. And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet. That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens. And it's not isolated growth anymore. We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America. That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation... And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak. So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build. What's different now is the pace. Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: ✅ Arkansas ✅ Florida ✅ Idaho ✅ Indiana ✅ Montana ✅ Nebraska ✅ Oklahoma ✅ South Carolina ✅ Texas ✅ Tennessee That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action. That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly. It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up. Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through. And right now, that's where we're stretched. We're not lacking interest or momentum. We're working to keep up with both. So here 's how you can help... Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it. An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: ✅ Constitutions. ✅ Chapter guides. ✅ Flags. ✅ Materials to organize and lead. It turns a student who wants to speak up... into one who actually does. And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here." Every activism kit you help sponsor means one more student is ready to lead instead of sitting on the sidelines. That's how we keep saying "yes" when the next student steps forward. That's how this movement actually scales. Because the reality is, the demand is here now. The only question is whether we're equipped to meet it. And that comes down to whether people like you decide to step in and help carry this forward. One final thing: I also wanted to say thank you. If you've supported Turning Point USA before -- whether once or many times -- you've already played a role in building what you're seeing right now. Students finding their voice. More state partnerships. New TPUSA chapters like the one at Charlie's former high school. This kind of momentum doesn't happen without people willing to stand behind it. And we don't take that lightly. I appreciate you taking the time to read this, and for everything you've already done to support this work. | | For Charlie, Andrew Sypher Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA P.S. Peter, what you're seeing right now is something we've been working toward for years -- a generation of young Americans who are no longer willing to sit quietly while the Left dominates their schools and culture. But moments like this don't sustain themselves. If we don't keep up, we lose ground. It's that simple. We need to keep pace with the growth happening right now -- to fund more activism kits, support more chapters, and make sure no student is left standing alone after they decide to speak up. If you've already supported Turning Point USA in the past, thank you for carrying this movement forward every single day. If you haven't yet, I'm asking you to step in now. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

subject: Volunteer with Team AOC!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
Help make sure our working-class movement goes back to Washington stronger than ever before.
#
In less than two weeks, Alexandria will face two primary opponents. **For her to win, we have to reach as many voters as possible across The Bronx and Queens before polls close on Tuesday, June 23rd.**
Our movement’s power has always come from the people. That’s why she won an upset in 2018, and how she continues to fight for the working class in Washington.
The more we grow our power, the harder we can push for our progressive values — that’s why we need you to volunteer with Team AOC!
[Can you sign up for a phone banking shift to help turn out voters before our June 23rd primary election?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/37552?utm_source=em20260612-11683&t=3&akid=11683%2E2526796%2EaBGXjJ)
**[Sign Up to Phonebank](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/37552?utm_source=em20260612-11683&t=4&akid=11683%2E2526796%2EaBGXjJ)**
Phonebanking is easy, fun, and can be done from the comfort of your home. We’ll give you the training you need, and we have time slots to fit your schedule.
**The billionaires would love nothing more than to see our movement stumble, but we’re not going to let that happen.**
By connecting directly with people across the district, we’ll make sure our working-class movement goes back to Washington stronger than ever before.
Thank you for all you do.
In solidarity,
Team AOC

**[Donate](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260612-org.Ds2eh0&refcode=em20260612-11683-P_ORG_VOL_ORG&t=1&akid=11683%2E2526796%2EaBGXjJ)** | **[Merch](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/9251?utm_source=em-footer-20260612-11683-P_ORG_VOL_ORG&t=2&akid=11683%2E2526796%2EaBGXjJ)**

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

In Colorado’s 1st congressional district, Justice Democrat Melat Kiros
recently went head-to-head with corporate stooge Diana DeGette in a debate
where Medicare for All was under attack.

The corporate-backed establishment incumbent pretends she doesn’t know why
we can’t pass guaranteed health care for everyone in this country, but
Melat exposed the ugly truth.

She called out DeGette directly, saying the only way we’ll pass Medicare
for All is “to vote out every single Congress member that is taking money
from Big Pharma and... preventing the legislation from actually getting
through to Congress.” 🔥

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260612-mk.jOWMse&refcode=em20260612-37897&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1002&akid=37897%2E1203867%2E2r6oJv ]Tweet from @MelatKirosCO: "With our democracy on the line, we have to
elect leaders who will pass Medicare for All, break up big medicine, and
cancel all medical debt."; attached in a still from a video, Melat is
saying "we HAVE to pass Medicare for All"

That means voting out DeGette, who’s taken a whopping $555,765 from 30
different Big Pharma PACs since the 2010 cycle.

Those massive checks keep her in line with the corporate agenda: don’t
give an inch to the working class, and never let Medicare for All pass.

DeGette has served in Congress for 30 years while the lives of working
people have only gotten harder. We have to kick her and every other
Do-Nothing Democrat holding up progress out of Congress to finally turn
things around.

Melat can win this primary and be a progressive champion for the working
class in Washington — but she can only do it with a surge of grassroots
support to overcome those corporate PAC checks in the final weeks of the
race.

today to help her win on June 30th and fight to pass Medicare for All in
Congress?

body:
| | [ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMYE5U9NTRbOMLNsSMiwuHsSrn4JnyYtk1EREaCYHldIw2Es-lCsKe-k7RYeRErCjUmpL6YWg0aqprxBCSlqaUKjL6uf8EDq6vQVEaFZEFWaTvOKtPnFc2PEalY2SnM4_7aGEvL8Wcn2Q6FHSZqryD6hQQBj79OAr4abtAvkZ9dxOwSSEB_PJZLNk3QzLJvL2F84blmcm4YsqrIrHtWwLKIDD-2I4VtxPwMLBZzEVieaihCdr5Zof4gV5AWvNEwHWnw/4rf/6dvRhnoITou_0OimQcnNfg/h0/h001.GvhcE1QzTaUFFkZAV9zm5WdNHVPcadxe68pLSS__iY0)
---
Peter, Texas ranchers have fed this country for generations. They have worked through drought and debt and every kind of hardship the land and the market could throw at them, and they have kept going because that is what Texans do. The last thing they needed was their own government dismantling the barrier that had kept a**flesh-eating parasite** off their land for 60 years. The New World screwworm, a parasitic fly that sickens and kills cattle, has been a non-issue for ranchers in the United States since 1966. It was eradicated through decades of careful, unglamorous prevention work, including a monitoring program in Central America that stopped it from ever reaching the Texas border. That program was a direct line of defense for every cattle operation in this state. **Trump unleashed Elon Musk 's DOGE and RFK Jr., and the program was killed in March 2025. **
---
[ **HOLD DOGE ACCOUNTABLE FOR TEXAS RANCHERS** ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquBEwNpKDUjb_IIr-2IelYD8wDhU5CC1oXzPi3rl4zoxarCKBcKsNrLW1fyWPg9-3Fg9aOYsbTvJ1P_7AAUnctP7Bi9sk03VI2VUeisLC06FWJ7R7n9ynKAOEg4TniZ2u_tCgAtjF3ltkqi6fyqQwJgaT5oJDtlNsifKR_qAgCpKMAqqWWmTdkiESvdvBUdUJmsHq2pp0Vnz27dnWfRwr_wF66UgDWb2jhXHZC5UGo0692a6qEMEbf0Jn7IuiJVyu9kQeOamClShdffV0rPhl1XEVe8mLzOEfC8fQI1jCjnnTgyHoNNQ6YrMFvLS7Zsr3EPYp2tWwdeVTJRLhv_Ho3P/4rf/6dvRhnoITou_0OimQcnNfg/h1/h001.n_pmzJZRv3r7yGO21BE05KmXN_r71HDGysUxYsoQeIY)

The screwworm had been marching north through Central America since 2023. Everyone tracking it knew where this would lead. And the administration cut the early warning system anyway. Now there is a confirmed case in a Texas calf near La Pryor while cattle inventories across the state are already at generational lows. The Trump administration's response has been to blame Joe Biden, a man who has not been president for a year and a half. [**Chip in whatever you can today to help us send leaders to Congress who protect Texas ranchers instead of using them as props.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquBEwNpKDUjb_IIr-2IelYD8wDhU5CC1oXzPi3rl4zoxarCKBcKsNrLW1fyWPg9-3Fg9aOYsbTvJ1P_7AAUnctPTEeXMXuvHUveXv_Ng2ydiEP7PAPVz8z_NSyUOpQbVbEpkeMVaCjLFrnBA8PNIWwTakpBdJCjIYG6SPv0Ay8A-uNnRGCQm3ETGmfkQkV3Tq01IeB6HYdWkcDXqBBrJ4LEWwuJknQbItcvXs9BPmf-64lY0-DzemJJ0Q2y6o5U57sgnavkwT_mMdzYZHUqDtCYhLChZxbi4k-0M86Sgpq4tApgDXHkQdMwYdqcSEoXePN6PVck3yN23Absheb_Zy52/4rf/6dvRhnoITou_0OimQcnNfg/h2/h001.aFluzXpSDO4NS6V2U_OijNu6hqTU-BZRax8iksGqwHg) Texas Agriculture Commissioner Sid Miller had to personally call the president and beg him to treat this like the crisis it is. Keith Self has had every opportunity to hold RFK Jr. and this administration accountable for the systematic gutting of the public health and agricultural infrastructure that Texas depends on. He has not taken one of them. Because loyalty to Trump matters more to Keith Self than the ranchers in his district who are now staring down a parasite their grandparents eradicated and wondering why nobody in Washington had their back. clean_body: | | Peter, Texas ranchers have fed this country for generations. They have worked through drought and debt and every kind of hardship the land and the market could throw at them, and they have kept going because that is what Texans do. The last thing they needed was their own government dismantling the barrier that had kept aflesh-eating parasite off their land for 60 years. The New World screwworm, a parasitic fly that sickens and kills cattle, has been a non-issue for ranchers in the United States since 1966. It was eradicated through decades of careful, unglamorous prevention work, including a monitoring program in Central America that stopped it from ever reaching the Texas border. That program was a direct line of defense for every cattle operation in this state. Trump unleashed Elon Musk 's DOGE and RFK Jr., and the program was killed in March 2025. The screwworm had been marching north through Central America since 2023. Everyone tracking it knew where this would lead. And the administration cut the early warning system anyway. Now there is a confirmed case in a Texas calf near La Pryor while cattle inventories across the state are already at generational lows. The Trump administration's response has been to blame Joe Biden, a man who has not been president for a year and a half. Texas Agriculture Commissioner Sid Miller had to personally call the president and beg him to treat this like the crisis it is. Keith Self has had every opportunity to hold RFK Jr. and this administration accountable for the systematic gutting of the public health and agricultural infrastructure that Texas depends on. He has not taken one of them. Because loyalty to Trump matters more to Keith Self than the ranchers in his district who are now staring down a parasite their grandparents eradicated and wondering why nobody in Washington had their back. Texas ranchers deserve representatives who do the unglamorous work of governing before the crisis hits. body:
On the road with Eric
| | | | | | [ ](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KTYC41Y1PJAYHK3E1J5DWEJF_0)
---
| **Welcome to the Barlow for Wyoming Newsletter. Your hub for latest news, information and upcoming events.**
---
|
---
| | |
---
| LEADERSHIP FOR WYOMING'S FUTURE
---
| Hi friends,We're hearing more conversations about the future of Wyoming and what people want in their next governor. We’ve had a lot of great one-on-one and association conversations, along with MANY good coffee shop and community stops.
The June and July calendars are already full, including a number of candidate forums hosted by various associations. Unfortunately, I can't get to every community forum. Thankfully, some of these organizations will post recordings from their events for you to watch. I want to be clear about my record, as I understand misleading and disingenuous information is circulating. In brief:
* I have always supported responsible energy development;
* I have never bought into the idea that we have to choose between strong industries and strong communities; and
* I have testified before Congress about the few irresponsible developers who negatively impacted downstream water, soils and private property rights.

Responsible developers in Wyoming know how to do it right, through relationships built on mutual respect, clear expectations, and fair dealing. In Wyoming, we develop responsibly so our children and their grandchildren can have the same opportunities on the landscapes that we have and love. Wyoming first, always. Thank you to everyone who continues to show up, ask thoughtful questions, share ideas, and stay engaged. Kelly and I are grateful for the support, and we look forward to seeing many more of you out on the road in the weeks ahead.If it seems like you haven't seen us in a while, just wait - we're headed back your way soon! \- Eric

Big Horn Ave, Moorcroft, WY\- Wheatland Senior Center Lunch, June 17th: 11-12:30PM, 1605 16th St, Wheatland, WY
---
| **On The Trail**
---
| | | **RAWLINS** Kelly and I spent last Saturday on the road. Beautiful landscapes on the way to Elk Mountain for a community meet and greet, then Rawlins for the Carbon County Block Party hosted by the Carbon County Museum.Thanks to all who hosted and shared information with us.
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | **CHEYENNE**

Kelly and I want to thank Rita Meyer, Larry Barttelbort, Lee Alley and Denise Burke for making last Friday’s Veterans for Barlow meet and greet such a great evening. I appreciated the opportunity to spend time with Wyoming’s veteran community, hear their stories, and talk about the issues that matter most to them and their families.
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | **GREEN RIVER**

Kelly and I were in Green River to meet with supporters and came away from the evening grateful.People across Wyoming have been so generous with their support, and it is propelling our campaign forward! Thank you to all who came to this event and have shown up at others across the state!
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | **ROCK SPRINGS**

In 2017, I authored a bill authorizing the display of the honor and remember flag as a symbol of gratitude and respect for the ultimate sacrifice made by members of the United States military in service to our nation.I was honored to present Jim McCollum with the ‘Honor to Remember’ flag that flew above our State Capitol when Lance Cpl. Rylee McCollum was honored by the Wyoming legislature and other Wyoming fallen heroes.Jim is the father of Lance Cpl. Rylee McCollum, a Wyoming Marine from Jackson who lost his life on his first deployment during the withdrawal from Afghanistan.Rylee was 20 years old. He was exactly where he wanted to be, doing something greater than himself. We owe it to families like the McCollum's to continue to honor his sacrifice.
---
| | |
---
| | | While in Rock Springs Kelly and I spent time talking with folks about the economic opportunities and challenges facing Sweetwater County and Wyoming as a whole. The conversations were good and honest, people here understand both what’s at stake and what’s possible.Wyoming’s economy works when we protect our core industries, energy, agriculture, and tourism, while creating space for new investment and innovation. That means reducing barriers for businesses, supporting workforce development, and making sure the decisions that shape this economy are made here in Wyoming, not in Washington.The people in Rock Springs are doing the work. Our job is to make sure the policies support them.
---
| | |
---
| | | I visited Memorial Hospital of Sweetwater County. Good conversations with the folks on the front lines of healthcare in this community.

Days like this are a good reminder that the people closest to the work are the ones who understand it best.
---
| | |
---
| | | In downtown Rock Springs, I got to see firsthand what revitalization looks like. We visited with Dan Pedri and his family at the Rock Springs IV Center, toured the old bank building with Danielle Salas, and spent some time at the Broadway Theatre.A strong Wyoming economy starts with strong communities. That means supporting small businesses, removing barriers to local investment, and trusting the people closest to the work to make the right calls. Rock Springs has all of that.
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | **KEMMERER
**
Kelly and I stopped into Fossil Fuel Coffee Company. Great coffee and great conversations about how we keep young people in the state, how to keep our energy economy moving, how to address healthcare needs, K-12 education, and more. This is why we love getting out and connecting with the people and places that make Wyoming special.
---
| | |
---
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | **BIG PINEY**
It was great to tour PureWest Energy. We had the opportunity to hear about their natural gas operations the Pinedale and Jonah Fields.
Natural gas production is core energy resource for Wyoming and we must keep government regulations are limited so producers have the best opportunity.We also got to visit with Jasmine Allison of PureWest about her award winning reclamation work. This is only the second time an oil and gas producer has been recognized with this award, and both were right here in Wyoming.
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | **STAR VALLEY** Kelly and I enjoyed time in Lincoln County with the team at LCSD #2 in Afton and visted with high school students in Cokeville.It’s always encouraging to sit down with educators who are showing up every day for Wyoming’s kids, and even more encouraging to meet young people who are sharp, motivated, and thinking seriously about their futures.Education decisions belong in the hands of Wyoming families and local school boards, and days like today remind us exactly why that matters
---
| | |
---
| | | Kelly and I visited Lower Valley Energy with Director of Gas Operations Craig Coles, toured Star Valley Hospital, and sat down with Mike Hunsaker, VP of Business Development.From the infrastructure that keeps families warm to the rural healthcare that keeps communities healthy, the people here are doing the work that matters most. Wyoming is strong because of folks like these.
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | **MEMORIAL DAY** On Memorial Day Kelly and I were honored to join the community in Jackson morning, where U.S. Air Force veteran Ed Liebzeit, Commander of VFW Post 4274, delivered remarks that reminded us why we gather on days of rememberance.Ed has spent years serving Wyoming's veteran community, and his words carry the weight of that dedication.We were reminded of why we fight to protect what we have here in Wyoming
---
| | |
---
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | **JACKSON**
The Million Dollar Music Fest in Jackson was a great summer kickoff!We heard amazing music and chatted with attendees in the town square. The famous Cowboy Bar and Wyoming sponsors do a great job with this annual community event!

---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | We had a great time supporting local artists at th Hootenany at the Pink Garter Theater.It has been such a great opportunity to be able to travel the state and meet people with so many gifts and talents that they share with others in their communities.

Responsible developers in Wyoming know how to do it right, through relationships built on mutual respect, clear expectations, and fair dealing. In Wyoming, we develop responsibly so our children and their grandchildren can have the same opportunities on the landscapes that we have and love. Wyoming first, always. Thank you to everyone who continues to show up, ask thoughtful questions, share ideas, and stay engaged. Kelly and I are grateful for the support, and we look forward to seeing many more of you out on the road in the weeks ahead.If it seems like you haven't seen us in a while, just wait - we're headed back your way soon! \- Eric | | | | | | | | | IN THE NEWS Cowboy State Daily Wyoming Tribune Eagle Cowboy State Daily | | | | \- Statewide Healthcare Policy Summit - Gubernatorial Candidate Forum, Friday, June 12th: 11:45AM - 3:00PM: University of Wyoming Conference Center 2221 Grand Ave, Laramie, WY-Wright Days: Taste of Wright, Friday, June 12th: 5:00 – 8:00PM, Wright, WY\- Wright Days Parade, Saturday, June 13th: 8:00 - 11:00AM, Wright, WY\- Dayton Meet & Greet, Sunday, June 14th: 4:30 - 7:00PM, Scott Bicentennial Park, Dayton, WY\- Coffee with the Barlows, June 16th: 9:00 - 10:30AM, Pine Haven Community Center, 3 Industrial Park, Pine Haven, WY\- Ice Cream Social, June 16th: 11:00 - 12:30PM, The Tin Cup, 112 S. Big Horn Ave, Moorcroft, WY\- Wheatland Senior Center Lunch, June 17th: 11-12:30PM, 1605 16th St, Wheatland, WY | On The Trail | | | RAWLINS Kelly and I spent last Saturday on the road. Beautiful landscapes on the way to Elk Mountain for a community meet and greet, then Rawlins for the Carbon County Block Party hosted by the Carbon County Museum.Thanks to all who hosted and shared information with us. | | | | | | | CHEYENNE Kelly and I want to thank Rita Meyer, Larry Barttelbort, Lee Alley and Denise Burke for making last Friday’s Veterans for Barlow meet and greet such a great evening. I appreciated the opportunity to spend time with Wyoming’s veteran community, hear their stories, and talk about the issues that matter most to them and their families. | | | | | | | GREEN RIVER Kelly and I were in Green River to meet with supporters and came away from the evening grateful.People across Wyoming have been so generous with their support, and it is propelling our campaign forward! Thank you to all who came to this event and have shown up at others across the state! | | | | | | | ROCK SPRINGS In 2017, I authored a bill authorizing the display of the honor and remember flag as a symbol of gratitude and respect for the ultimate sacrifice made by members of the United States military in service to our nation.I was honored to present Jim McCollum with the ‘Honor to Remember’ flag that flew above our State Capitol when Lance Cpl. Rylee McCollum was honored by the Wyoming legislature and other Wyoming fallen heroes.Jim is the father of Lance Cpl. Rylee McCollum, a Wyoming Marine from Jackson who lost his life on his first deployment during the withdrawal from Afghanistan.Rylee was 20 years old. He was exactly where he wanted to be, doing something greater than himself. We owe it to families like the McCollum's to continue to honor his sacrifice. | | | | | | While in Rock Springs Kelly and I spent time talking with folks about the economic opportunities and challenges facing Sweetwater County and Wyoming as a whole. The conversations were good and honest, people here understand both what’s at stake and what’s possible.Wyoming’s economy works when we protect our core industries, energy, agriculture, and tourism, while creating space for new investment and innovation. That means reducing barriers for businesses, supporting workforce development, and making sure the decisions that shape this economy are made here in Wyoming, not in Washington.The people in Rock Springs are doing the work. Our job is to make sure the policies support them. | | | | | | I visited Memorial Hospital of Sweetwater County. Good conversations with the folks on the front lines of healthcare in this community. Days like this are a good reminder that the people closest to the work are the ones who understand it best. | | | | | | In downtown Rock Springs, I got to see firsthand what revitalization looks like. We visited with Dan Pedri and his family at the Rock Springs IV Center, toured the old bank building with Danielle Salas, and spent some time at the Broadway Theatre.A strong Wyoming economy starts with strong communities. That means supporting small businesses, removing barriers to local investment, and trusting the people closest to the work to make the right calls. Rock Springs has all of that. | | | | | | | KEMMERER Kelly and I stopped into Fossil Fuel Coffee Company. Great coffee and great conversations about how we keep young people in the state, how to keep our energy economy moving, how to address healthcare needs, K-12 education, and more. This is why we love getting out and connecting with the people and places that make Wyoming special. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | BIG PINEY It was great to tour PureWest Energy. We had the opportunity to hear about their natural gas operations the Pinedale and Jonah Fields. Natural gas production is core energy resource for Wyoming and we must keep government regulations are limited so producers have the best opportunity.We also got to visit with Jasmine Allison of PureWest about her award winning reclamation work. This is only the second time an oil and gas producer has been recognized with this award, and both were right here in Wyoming. | | | | | | | STAR VALLEY Kelly and I enjoyed time in Lincoln County with the team at LCSD #2 in Afton and visted with high school students in Cokeville.It’s always encouraging to sit down with educators who are showing up every day for Wyoming’s kids, and even more encouraging to meet young people who are sharp, motivated, and thinking seriously about their futures.Education decisions belong in the hands of Wyoming families and local school boards, and days like today remind us exactly why that matters | | | | | | Kelly and I visited Lower Valley Energy with Director of Gas Operations Craig Coles, toured Star Valley Hospital, and sat down with Mike Hunsaker, VP of Business Development.From the infrastructure that keeps families warm to the rural healthcare that keeps communities healthy, the people here are doing the work that matters most. Wyoming is strong because of folks like these. | | | | | | | MEMORIAL DAY On Memorial Day Kelly and I were honored to join the community in Jackson morning, where U.S. Air Force veteran Ed Liebzeit, Commander of VFW Post 4274, delivered remarks that reminded us why we gather on days of rememberance.Ed has spent years serving Wyoming's veteran community, and his words carry the weight of that dedication.We were reminded of why we fight to protect what we have here in Wyoming | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | JACKSON The Million Dollar Music Fest in Jackson was a great summer kickoff!We heard amazing music and chatted with attendees in the town square. The famous Cowboy Bar and Wyoming sponsors do a great job with this annual community event! | | | | | | | We had a great time supporting local artists at th Hootenany at the Pink Garter Theater.It has been such a great opportunity to be able to travel the state and meet people with so many gifts and talents that they share with others in their communities. | | | | Get In The Saddle | | | | | | | Wyoming’s strength has always come from neighbors pitching in. Hey folks,
**Joe Walsh** and I jumped on for one of those conversations that starts in one place and somehow ends up somewhere way more interesting.
We talked about Trump's endless need to make everything about himself, the insanity surrounding the Epstein fallout, some brutal Senate race debates, and then landed on something I think a lot of people are wrestling with right now: what it actually means to be a man in 2026.
**Here 's what we got into:**
* [**00:01:07**] Joe makes the case for ignoring Trump's birthday spectacle and military parade, and we dig into Trump's obsession with cultural relevance.
* [**00:08:45**] We talk openly about burnout, audience fatigue, summer politics, and why so many people just want to live their lives instead of doomscrolling.
* [**00:15:00**] A heated debate over Texas and Maine Senate races turns into a bigger conversation about candidate quality, electability, and political reality.
* [**00:22:00**] We wrestle with accountability, redemption, and where the line should be when candidates face serious allegations and controversies.
* [**00:34:00**] The conversation shifts to masculinity, Andrew Tate, Jason Kelce, protecting the people you love, and why Democrats need a stronger answer for young men.

This episode covers a lot of ground, but the thread running through all of it is responsibility--responsibility in politics, responsibility in leadership, and responsibility in our personal lives. If you've been trying to make sense of where the country is headed, why so many people feel disconnected, or how we build something better, this one's worth your time. If you value honest conversations like this, help me keep them going.

With urgency,
--Mike

Folks, if this were the other way around, with a quarterback introducing a Democratic President, they’d be glorified across the country.

But because it’s a Republican – because it’s President Trump – Dart gets raked over the coals for it.

_**The saying “there’s no ‘I’ in ‘team’” may be overused, but it’s true.**_

We have got to come together. We can’t live as a football team, we can’t live as a state, we can’t live as a country if we have this type of dissension and hypocrisy.

This is what I’m fighting for. I’m fighting for Americans to come together and worry about being Americans.

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

SpaceX shares under ticker **[SPCX surged nearly 25% shortly after opening trading](https://substack.com/redirect/811be62a-e35b-41ce-bbdf-086e20826c2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/811be62a-e35b-41ce-bbdf-086e20826c2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)following completion of the biggest IPO ever, pushing the company valuation above two trillion dollars and making Elon Musk the world's first trillionaire.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a93be760-0a95-44dc-86d3-a1d93af528ba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

* **SPCX Opening Surge:** Shares opened at $150 dollars, 11% above the $135 dollar IPO price, before climbing further in heavy volume.
* **Valuation Tops Two Trillion:** Early gains drove SpaceX market capitalization past two2 trillion dollars on its Nasdaq debut.
* **Musk Achieves Trillionaire Status:** The rocket company's successful trading debut elevated Elon Musk to the world's first trillionaire.
* **Investor Demand Explosive:** Proxy space stocks and options volumes boomed as traders scrambled for any exposure to the historic IPO.

# [Melania Trump launches portable foster youth asset accounts](https://substack.com/redirect/a93be760-0a95-44dc-86d3-a1d93af528ba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
First Lady Melania Trump introduced Fostering the Future accounts at the Treasury Department, **[creating portable financial resources so foster youth gain personal asset ownership](https://substack.com/redirect/3ca7193b-3a5f-438a-825c-3c4b5e8570e5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and fiscal autonomy upon reaching adulthood.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a93be760-0a95-44dc-86d3-a1d93af528ba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Portable Asset Ownership:** The accounts belong solely to the young person and move with them despite frequent placements between homes and families.
* **Twenty Three States Committed:** All red states have already agreed to fund the accounts, giving access at maturity for any use chosen.
* **Pairs With Scholarships:** The financial tool complements existing Fostering the Future scholarships to help recipients become independently wealthy and self-supporting.
* **Nonpartisan Future Focus:** The initiative strengthens America's workforce and economy, urging all governors and private donors to join without regard to politics.
