Peter, Through relentless gerrymandering, Republicans have made it clear they will lie, cheat, and steal to insulate Donald Trump and the Republican Congress from consequences at the ballot box. But we, the people, still hold power in America — and here’s how we’re fighting back. **We just rolled out a robust, multi-front strategy to defeat Trump’s gerrymandering — and ultimately prevent it from ever happening again.** Today, I want to dive deep into the very first pillar of our plan: DEFEND against more Republican power grabs. [**But before I dive in, can you make a donation to help fund this massive undertaking? People power is how we’re going to execute this plan — and win.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133226999/627144696/1548394306?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_PathForwardPt1_email_20260612-NDRC-Tier1-PathForwardPt1_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260612-NDRC-Tier1-PathForwardPt1_&utm_campaign=PathForwardPt1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQzOTUzMzcyLTliNjYtZjExMS04ZmNiLTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=2KUF4Okgd8WvkR4Id6xQ1GJf8VUqdpCyqD3RPT2l29k=) Let’s start by stating facts: Trump and Republicans launched an unprecedented effort to maximize partisan advantage ahead of the midterms — and they did so by**deliberately diminishing minority voting power.** The first domino to fall was Texas, triggering Missouri and North Carolina to fall in line. But the Supreme Court’s disastrous decision in _Louisiana v. Callais_ unleashed an even more disgraceful set of gerrymanders. New maps in Tennessee, Louisiana, and Alabama will diminish or even completely erase Black voters’ ability to access equal representation. Republicans see plenty of opportunities to take this shameful strategy to the next level for 2028. **In order to meet this moment, we must treat each state individually and aggressively defend against GOP gerrymanders in places like Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Indiana, Louisiana, Mississippi, Missouri, South Carolina, Tennessee, and Texas. ** Here’s what that looks like:
* **Preventing and overturning** gerrymanders through grassroots mobilization and voter referendums.
* **Educating eligible voters** with the information they need to build political power and make their voices heard, such as registering to vote.
* **Enforcing voting laws** in both state and federal courts to combat efforts to undermine Americans’ right to vote.

This work is happening right now. And it’ll lay the foundation for how we’re able to protect free and fair elections, equal representation, and voting rights for months and years to come. **But this is no small feat — and it’s only Part One of the plan. We’re counting on your grassroots support to power this work and ensure we can restore fairness in democracy.**

## Priest Chases Down Car Theft Suspect
The Rev. Canon Jean-Baptiste Commins was standing in his church parking lot when he heard tires squeal and a crash outside [Saint Joseph Shrine](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyskL3OnTAQRJ8GOiN7MT8uXKSh-9KmRAavYRODkb33krx9xFUeIe3oaDRnfnzNX44indt3d6ANW5g5pPnEu0RkxjwHxzvmks7yyhums5QUPWEuM0joheyFgvnKqVy48qxrbwMiYFujVcOowHRDO9a7XbVptRtdN0iHpjMGNLTGjIvyo1q1rMk-hbJXABJADc24wKAUqKUzCpz2lZboiVNufiY6eccQ_6Q35mZNRx3tznyVqv1WwVTBdN93E9Jv8Mg5ET9MBdPjVcH0LxRXJiwsFlzTgUWsmQ4Ugbad6dzElpIXxR0uE7tTsFt_xYdyWfBOGER5faTrbP11U4xU-qHScjscxc8o_h-Hvi38DQAA__-tpZC-) in Detroit. An 18-year-old suspect had crashed a stolen car into another vehicle and was sprinting away from the scene with one shoe on. When someone yelled, "Stop him," the French-born priest, wearing a [full cassock](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJys0LGu4yAUBNCvsTssuHYAFxTbuMu2WyJsLja7BCy4ibV__5S8X3j9aEZn_tzt3cUU8_7bPdCEPVgKxWa8WkIirDY4OrC2ktuz7lhyayX5iLVZ4CAZl0yAPWtpJ25kp96bgAg49miE0gLmmxp1fxh9W-XsV3Q8zEHwFZRWq5aoPUcJfuyjeRdyKQA4gFCDXkEJAWK9zQLc5LuJo49U6vC3xEwHhvS_vLAOW3n0yRxEZ-vGXx0sHSzXdQ15q7jHRt-RDpY3q4PlwFrYWSM2YuS2fwkba88PgB2RWH1m5pFqidRX488rphSbVN3E94eL6TNIP3HWy8BXAAAA__8WUIQR), took off running. Jean-Baptiste tackled the suspect and, with help from another church member, held him down until police arrived. The 18-year-old was arrested, and three others were detained. The woman in the other vehicle suffered non-life-threatening injuries. After the suspect was in custody, Jean-Baptiste rushed back to check on the injured woman and see whether she needed a blessing or the Anointing of the Sick. He then returned to his [evening prayers and dinner](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyskM1uhSAUhJ8Gdxo44t-CRZPG3e22S4NwUFoUA8dr7ts33mfoZjLJJJP55vsxPbQPfl--9IbKLW4iF6cdrxyQCNPkNK2YctzzmRaMe84xWI8pT8ChLXlbCpiOFPOBhiZZWOUQAesCleh6AUPT1X2xKl3PvIeOz3oAOXfa6YY3DnCQdQvNMBRe3YW8FQAcQHRVP0MnBIi5GQRoaZnkaD3FVP1Ev9OKLrziE1Nl4lYEtRIdmdUfDEYG43Vd1UuvMd4pg_EmYjCet-hE3gS8rUVK0VN5JI-ZStLmN2Au8_nGQVsanUohmlZK0bTVSltg9bicxsRzJ0ys_hRFUva4fAg-tx2TfNm0D-9R9B-HPhX8BQAA__9ckY29) with his community. "_Just another day in the D_ ," he said.
## Father-Son Surgeons Make History
Dr. Joseph Wasselle Sr. spent decades as a vascular surgeon at [Orlando Health Melbourne Hospital](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJys0LGOpSAUxvGngQ4DRxQtKLaxu9tuSVAOyi6CAe41-_aTO5N5g6m_5J_8vj8P87AhhrT_tidqv3vTfDYJ7xqxNSzG23ZgqTnVZ9kxp1pzdAFLNcBhZHxkAsxVcr1wa0ZSpz0iYE9RCzUJmAfVT_TQqpfbDJMSs-Ao5SCHSXo-e_Sr6CdwNOh3kI8CgAMI1U0rKCFArMMswEpHJEcXWi7d3xxSO9DH__mFpdvySaM-Wrsq6X8RWAgs9313Nsf3RmCxpYUtYiWwfHlYzYl9i9iFxedysr3kZ3JrQfsvpJ3xmXPOR9l3RzsjLdpdd4gx1FERyffThs8-bT_x20vDRwAAAP__EjqFhA) in Florida. This year, his son, Dr. Joseph Wasselle Jr., joined the same hospital's staff. Months later, the two found themselves working side by side during a groundbreaking procedure. The younger Wasselle, 34, was performing an endovascular aneurysm repair when his father stopped by to observe and ultimately [scrubbed in to assist](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJys0MFutCAUBeCn0R0T7xVRFyz-zezm33ZJUC5Kg0AAnfbtm2nTN-j6JCfnO28P9dDOu7D91wdJu1lVbVSBnsVTrZSV1XWnXGIoZ94ohlKiN45yUdihYJ1ggCrlWBKtVfHWSEuE1LckYZwA52Hsp3aX1g4wd6vmy8CtAGFsP3E-Lppb4HYUrZOvwk4AYocI421acARAWIYZUHPT8I6MqzHf3qMLdSfrP-NF-bbGo_VyrzWVpv_X4L3Be6KYPL2iBu8_BqaDYSUGdumynl5n9ktiibKN-WCH81RqDMRSjiuZMxOjj9WfxV3EAOYZxDC1WZr0dN67IsaGd9uhnf9eUf_iwUviVwAAAP__zeCK5Q). The operation marked the first time an Orlando Health facility performed the minimally invasive procedure in a cardiac catheterization lab rather than a traditional operating room, a technique that can speed patient recovery. Both attended the University of South Florida College of Medicine decades apart and were mentored by some of the same physicians. "_None of those moments are quite as fulfilling as being able to show your dad what you have become_ ," Dr. Wasselle Jr. said. His father put it simply: "_I am so proud of Joe—my son, my colleague_."
## From Classroom Clash to Lifesaving Gift
Montana Miller couldn't stand her fifth-grade teacher. She found his reading assignments too easy, challenged him constantly, and her parents eventually had her [pulled from his class](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyskLHO3CAQhJ8Gd3uCvbOxC4pr3P1pU1rYLIYIsxaQc5Knj5xnSP2NRvPN96_ly8YU8_7NHmT87pfmecl01UStUVm8bYFK5Vx_lp0418rJRSp1QYkDyAEULmfhetLWllfnjCdCenZklB4VTr1-jl0wKw2Dm_p1XNXqBuxx0tQruWlpraZp6qK5C-WgECWi0o9xRa0UqrWfFNqXEy9JLjYujx8ccwvk02_-UHlsfHTJhNbOKp5vgbPA-bqux1HzzQTOlOFXEjjfXgJnvpXuEB82wxUYEt-aDgIVqK3ErYGPvgXYi3UEjex2I1vBwhZicrDxQRU8l8sWB42h2g9BiBVS9CRwtgXeb3z-2SfdFePOK6YU66DFS-6Hjenf7PY_Lv8Y_BsAAP__1gGa2Q). "_I absolutely could not stand him_ ," she said. "_It was a battle of the minds, a battle of wills_." Decades later, Montana, now 55, [reconnected with Mitchell Grosky](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJys0LGOnDAQBuCngW6QPbCwFBRp6C5tSuTDY-zEeJDHt9a-fUTyCteOPo3-___1sX2YEEM6fpqTFne4rTjeElWJVArlzZniKQsn-coHcRLhaANl2VDhCGoEjduVWS7ayza0dnFESH1Li56eGufH1D9bv1hr3WwGPex67ienxnl40GxGNdIwWd23YbkfqlEjKkQ9dc9PnLRG_fmYNZrBNoMiGwrn7jeHVDy5-OYX5W7ns42LL-WSpv_R4NrgWmvtIqcjSDTJ3qTB9a7V4KoegApwbHC9Cfw3UPk0Capn8KaQBU8ZzmBtJJDdM0coZPb7emSuAl8XCEUXSSS-wXIyhQR8OMHAn2ATvTtfztjmxV41xBhknJpBHacJ8V_m8h17vxb8GwAA___zIJqb), 74, on Facebook. She discovered they shared similar values and interests, and the two became genuine friends. They reunited in person in 2019 while she was training for a world championship parachute event in Massachusetts, where Grosky, an accomplished photographer, snapped pictures of her skydiving. When Miller learned through social media that Grosky was battling kidney disease and needed a transplant, she got tested and turned out to be a match. In April, she donated her kidney to the teacher she once dreaded. "_When I was ten years old I hated his guts; now I'm giving him mine!?_ " [Miller wrote on Facebook](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyskL_S2yAQxJ8GdXjg9NcFRRp1X9qUGmwOuASBBu6T47fPyM-QYpvdmd2d36-v7ctSohx-2h2ND35jX7aMr5aQGevmLUesreT2XQOW3FpJjrC2DRRMUk1Sw3bU0g588jZ0znhEwL5Do-dFw32c-6WLpreq14jj4pR1anH3aejHxzjjZDVYNXdkrkI1aQAFoOfb8oBZa9CP8a7BDk4MCh1xqbffhTJH9OldTqy3Z9m7ZCLz0UT_Q8AqYHWW0vss9MQrFrDmt4D1KJXly7ZIOXDJAlZfyy5JRsvoZKQmwzc3yUU2e1IOHyuRR5lIvspuswx0YpP4VzLaZ8QqL_0hl_Fa6Kpxx4tSojbNYlBht5Q-D_l_0D0N_AsAAP__13eUZQ). clean_body: We need Kurt Alme in the United States Senate. | I have a clear and urgent request for you, Fellow Patriot. We have an open U.S. Senate seat in Montana, and while this seat has long been considered safely Republican, we cannot afford to take anything for granted in this environment. Our Senate map this cycle is challenging. Republicans are defending far more seats than Democrats, and our resources are stretched across the country. Open seats like this one demand early attention and strong grassroots support. Kurt Alme has spent his career serving the people of Montana as a prosecutor, public servant, and leader committed to the rule of law. He served as U.S. Attorney during both Trump Administrations, focusing on public safety, combating drug trafficking, and protecting Montana communities. Now, he's stepping forward to serve again, but he won't have an easy path. Democrats see this race as a top opportunity. They will spend heavily, organize aggressively, and do everything they can to flip this seat. We've seen this playbook before – flooding states with outside money and misleading attacks in an effort to gain control of the Senate. We can't let that happen here. Kurt just got into this race. He needs the resources to introduce himself to voters, share his record, and communicate a clear conservative vision for Montana's future. This race is about more than one seat. It's about maintaining a Senate Republican majority that can advance a conservative agenda, confirm strong judicial nominees, and provide a check on Washington's excesses. If we lose ground here, we risk losing our ability to lead effectively. Kurt Alme is the kind of candidate we need. He's steady, principled, and focused on results. I hope you'll stand with us. John Thune Republican Leader P.S. Montana is a critical hold for Republicans, and this open seat will be a top target for Democrats. body:
Especially this month.

Team, Happy Pride Month 🏳️🌈 🏳️⚧️ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133227884/627147409/-235326371?refcode=260612_sm_pride&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NWViZTY4Ni05ZTY2LWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aLYLFc8ZQTDfllvWHo_vnsli_Pyl0Ta2yNzL0oJEsSg=&emci=ae869b3a-1566-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&emdi=65ebe686-9e66-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&ceid=194769) This month, I'm thinking about how far we've come, how much the Trump administration has tried to undo progress, and how much work is still left to do. We, alongside and in support of the LGBTQIA+ community, are watching hard-won rights and protections come under attack again and again. Too many people in positions of power are treating basic dignity and equality like partisan issues. That's why I am clear about where I stand. Everyone deserves the freedom to live openly, safely, and with dignity. I've been leading a months-long effort to reinstate funding for the “press 3” option of 988 for LGBTQIA+ youth, a lifesaving mental health resource. I am a longtime cosponsor of the Equality Act, as well as the Transgender Bill of Rights from its first introduction in Congress. And I’m a proud cosponsor of the “No Place for LGBTQ+ Hate Act,” which would repeal five of Trump’s most harmful executive orders targeting the LGBTQIA+ community. Not to make a political statement, but because it is the right thing to do. No one should be treated as less than equal in the country they call home. Equality is not optional, and it is a promise worth fighting for. Wishing you a joyful Pride Month. — Seth
| | |
---|---|---

### About Seth Moulton
Seth Moulton is a Marine and a Democrat with a mission to bring a new generation of leaders to Congress. Seth’s two young daughters, Emmy and Caroline, remind him every day why new leadership and urgent action can’t wait any longer.

subject: I’m humbled and honored
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Committee to Elect Aaron Ford
body:
**BREAKING: Republican Steve Hilton is our opponent in the general election for California Governor!**
We’re entering a new stage in our fight, and we cannot afford to slow down. I can’t win the general election against a Trump loyalist on my own.
So I am asking you directly:
**[Will you please split a $5 contribution between my campaign for California governor and Aaron Ford today? Your donation, no matter how big or small, will help us ensure a Democrat sits in the governor’s office next January.](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260612_1_ak.jabgrP&amount=5&refcode=em20260612-283&t=2&akid=287%2E127862%2E_LBAc5)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260612_1_ak.jabgrP&amount=5&refcode=em20260612-283&t=21&akid=287%2E127862%2E_LBAc5)**
My parents, Manuel and Maria, came to this country with $12 in their pockets. That’s it. $12 to build a life for my family. I was born and raised in Sacramento, where they taught my siblings and me the value of hard work.
My father worked in construction. My mother worked clerical jobs. It wasn’t easy. But they worked hard and saved every penny they could to provide a better life for their children.
Despite those humble beginnings, they were able to own a home, send the four of us kids to college or the military, and set aside enough to retire with dignity.
**To me, that’s the California Dream – and that’s what I’m fighting to defend in this race for California governor.**
Because today, despite having the largest economy in the country, that dream of owning a home, raising a family, and retiring with dignity is all too hard for Californians to attain. That’s why I’m promising to build our state’s economy, create opportunities and lower costs for working families, and protect the California we all love. And it’s why I am in this fight.
But the second half of this race will be no easy feat.

That is why it is absolutely disgraceful that Maine's presumptive Democratic nominee would stoop so low as to attack our service members. How could anyone who served slam our own troops like that? name: David Hogg
subject: Mai Vang advances in CA-07 🎉
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
Mai Vang took on a 48-year political dynasty and came out on top — now she’s headed to the General Election in CA-07.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260612-1&t=1&akid=3594%2E587540%2E5VSX4d)
Peter,
**Mai Vang is officially headed to the General Election in CA-07!** 🎉
Mai took on a 48-year political dynasty — _and won_. Her opponent, incumbent Doris Matsui, had twice the campaign resources, AIPAC money in her warchest, hundreds of thousands from defense contractors, and the full backing of the Sacramento political establishment. **_Mai still came out on top._**
That’s not just a win, it’s a statement about the future of CA-07 and the Democratic Party.
One where working class communities finally have a seat at the table. One where corporate money and establishment backing don’t automatically decide who gets to represent a district. And one where the candidate with the _right_ message and real roots in their community can beat the machine.
**This is our 14th win this cycle, and we’re incredibly proud to have supported Mai in this race. She’s exactly the kind of candidate we were built to back.**
Being a working mom and the daughter of Hmong refugees who grew up on SNAP and Medicaid in the same community she’s been fighting for her entire life — that matters. It means she never needed a briefing to understand what working families in Sacramento are up against. It’s a reality she’s lived herself.
**If Mai wins in November, she’ll make history as the first Hmong American ever elected to Congress.** I won’t sugar coat it, this race will be competitive. Mai will be facing Matsui again in a head-to-head matchup. But she just proved that she has what it takes to win, _even when the establishment goes all in against her._
The momentum is real, the grassroots energy behind her campaign is palpable, and her deep ties to the community set her apart from her opponent. What Mai needs right now are the resources to sustain her fight all the way to November.
**[Pitch in $5 now to help Leaders We Deserve keep backing Mai and young, fearless leaders just like her.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260612_1_mai.mKq82m&refcode=em20260612-3594&amount=5&t=2&akid=3594%2E587540%2E5VSX4d)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260612_1_mai.mKq82m&amount=5&refcode=em20260612-3594&t=21&akid=3594%2E587540%2E5VSX4d)**
Thank you,
David Hogg
P.S. If it confuses you that Mai won her primary but is still running against her Democratic opponent in November, don’t worry! It’s because of California’s unique primary system. They have a non-partisan primary system where the top two from the primary, no matter the party, advance to the General.

**I’m officially the Democratic nominee for Governor of Iowa.**

The other big development? **I’ll face Kansas resident Zach Lahn in the general election.**

Zach Lahn claims to be some kind of outsider despite being in lockstep with (or even MORE extreme than) Kim Reynolds in basically every way that counts. Yet he’s trying to convince us that the solution to ten years of failed one-party rule is... _four more years of one-party rule._

Clearly, there’s an extraordinary amount at stake in this election, and it’s really, really important that we come out on top in November.

**[Will you become one of the early supporters of the general election by splitting a donation between my campaign and Andy Beshear’s In This Together PAC today? Your contribution will lay the groundwork for everything we do in the next five months and everything we achieve in the next four years.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133229130/627151550/1031342027?refcode=em26_260612_sand_fnd_gq_act___rs_ettx&utm_campaign=em26_260612_sand_fnd_gq_act___rs_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=687c76bd-a166-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTAzNjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjg3Yzc2YmQtYTE2Ni1mMTExLThmY2ItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=cJdyzmOF9wb2efq2l8zVPviONKDDigU9I7M5QZ0umws=)** [Split a Donation](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133229131/627151551/1031342027?refcode=em26_260612_sand_fnd_gq_act___rs_ettx&utm_campaign=em26_260612_sand_fnd_gq_act___rs_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=687c76bd-a166-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTAzNjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjg3Yzc2YmQtYTE2Ni1mMTExLThmY2ItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=cJdyzmOF9wb2efq2l8zVPviONKDDigU9I7M5QZ0umws=) I’ve been traveling to all 99 counties every year since I first ran for Auditor back in 2017. There’s one thing EVERYBODY — Democrat, Republican, independent, etc. — can agree on: **the status quo is failing the majority of Iowans.**

We’re in the grips of a generational farm crisis, mass layoffs, education cuts, rising cancer rates, rural hospital closures, brain drain, and **an economy that ranks 45th in the country.**

These are real problems that affect real people. Meanwhile, Zach Lahn is palling around with Steve King and fighting “radicalism” in fifth-grade math textbooks. 🙄

Iowans are fighting an uphill battle just to make ends meet. They’re tired, and tired of fighting. It’s time to leave the culture wars behind.

This race is a toss-up, according to the experts at _Cook Political Report_ , **because we’ve built one of the broadest bipartisan coalitions in American politics.** That’s why the choice we face in this election is so much more than (D) or (R). It’s between a divisive culture warrior or a proven public servant who brings people together.

I believe Iowans will see the contrast, but winning requires us to be realistic about the challenges we’re facing.

**Our success depends on whether we can sustain our incredible grassroots energy in the months ahead.**

The investments from over 60,000 small-dollar donors propelled us to this moment. Now I’m asking each and every one of you to become one of the first founding donors of my general election campaign.

With both the Senate and House on the line, we have a lot to consider.
#
Peter,
At the end of the month, we’re going to hit what is arguably the most important fundraising deadline of the 2026 campaign.
It’s important because, when it’s over, we’re going to look at the money we’ve raised so far this year, and then we’re going to look at the map of races we need to win to take back the House and Senate this November.
From that point, we’ve got to make some tough decisions.
Can we afford to run ads for first time candidates running for House — like we’ve done for Navy Helicopter pilot Rebecca Bennett in New Jersey? Do we need to dig deep in Iowa, particularly rural Iowa, where our messengers resonate? Can we flip Florida, with all the Veterans and Military Families there?
We’ve invested a lot already because we had a good year in 2025. But what we raise before this FEC deadline will determine what we can do next. With both the Senate and House on the line, we have a lot to consider.

name: Voto Latino
subject: California’s 48th Congressional District is up for grabs
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Voto Latino
body:
Our job is to make sure our community is registered, informed, and ready to vote.
#
Peter,
**Republican Rep. Darrell Issa announced his retirement earlier this year, and his open seat in California’s 48th Congressional District is now up for grabs this November.**
In a House fight that could come down to a handful of seats, races like CA-48, **where Latinos make up 30% of the population** , will determine who controls Congress.
Latino voters will be a deciding force in districts like this one, which is why California is a top priority this cycle with voter registration, early voter contact, and turnout work.
[**If you’re ready to help power that work right now, will you rush a $3 donation to Voto Latino today?**](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260612-1-ak.xwvGsf&amount=3&refcode=em20260612-245&t=1&akid=245%2E1366028%2EAtxaqQ)
After voters approved Proposition 50, which put more congressional seats in California in play, CA-48 became one of the country’s most important battlegrounds.
With Issa out, Democrats have a real opening to flip it and build a House majority that can actually govern. But Republicans are working overtime to keep this seat in their hands.
**That’s why we’re supporting the democratic nominee, Marni von Wilpert.** She’s a San Diego City Councilmember and former workers’ rights attorney who has earned support from labor and education leaders and has already proven she can win tough races by building a broad coalition.
Our job is to make sure our community, who will decide these races, is registered, informed, and ready to vote. That means meeting people where they are, turning voter registration into real turnout, and making sure Latino voters know what’s on the line before November arrives. But we can’t do it alone.
**[Can you chip in $3 today to help Voto Latino mobilize in CA-48, protect and flip key California seats, and build the power our communities deserve?](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260612-1-ak.xwvGsf&amount=3&refcode=em20260612-245&t=2&akid=245%2E1366028%2EAtxaqQ)**
**[Donate $3 ››](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260612-1-ak.xwvGsf&amount=3&refcode=20260612-245&t=21&akid=245%2E1366028%2EAtxaqQ)**
Thank you,
Voto Latino

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: Fighting back — together
body:
Building a movement made of people who are ready to say enough is enough.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
Right now, our public schools are on life support. We have the most uninsured children in the country. And our power grids are failing.
All of this is thanks to Greg Abbott selling us out to his Very Hungry Billionaires.
**We’re launching a new ad to get this message out to voters across Texas, but we wanted you to be the first to see it.**
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260612_2_ad.g936c0&refcode=em20260612-1329&amount=5&t=1&akid=1329%2E299639%2E0G1Rd4)
We need to launch this ad soon, but getting it on the air takes serious resources, so we need to move fast.
[**We set an emergency goal to raise $50,000 so we can launch this ad as soon as we can. Will you pitch in $5 right now to help us get our new ad in front of voters across Texas?**](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260612_2_ad.g936c0&refcode=em20260612-1329&amount=5&t=2&akid=1329%2E299639%2E0G1Rd4)
**This fight is personal, Peter.**
I ran for office the first time to stop politicians from shutting down my son’s school — and we won.
I’ve seen what happens when everyday people lock arms, organize, and refuse to let politicians abandon us.
That’s the kind of spirit I’m bringing to this race, but I can’t do this alone.
Each and every one of you who donates today will help get our message out to voters and stand up to Abbott and his billionaires.**
**
**[So, if you can, please donate $5 or whatever you can today to help us hit our emergency $50,000 goal and get our new ad on the air.](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260612_2_ad.g936c0&refcode=em20260612-1329&amount=5&t=3&akid=1329%2E299639%2E0G1Rd4)**

Thank you,
Gina

On Donald Trump’s first day in office, he signed an executive order to “end the weaponization of the federal government.” But don’t be fooled, Peter: The only weaponization of the federal government has been done by Donald Trump. Trump’s weaponization of government in his second term has eclipsed the extent of his first tenfold. In the last Congress, I served on the Select Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government created by Jim Jordan — and take it from me, the only purpose of this committee was to shield Donald Trump from any sort of accountability. Republicans have spent years interfering in ongoing criminal investigations and making unsupported allegations against Trump’s perceived enemies. Every single one has been politically motivated. **Trump’s allies aren’t interested whatsoever in ending the weaponization of the federal government. Peter, I’ve been crisscrossing the state on my Make Stuff Cost Less campaign tour, talking with and listening to North Carolinians directly, and I keep hearing versions of the same thing:
🚨 Everything from gas to groceries is getting unaffordable.

🏠 Buying a house and planning for the future seems unthinkable.

🇺🇲 The American Dream feels unattainable.
**Stuff costs too much, and nobody in Washington DC seems to care.**
When I hear things like this, I know it’s time to get to work. That’s why I’m in this fight. As North Carolina’s next U.S. Senator, I will put the people before power, party and politics – as I did for eight years as Governor:
✅ We expanded Medicaid for hundreds of thousands of working North Carolinians.

✅ We added hundreds of thousands of good-paying jobs.

✅ We increased teacher pay and expanded paid parental leave.
**Now, I’m ready to bring this North Carolina common sense to the U.S. Senate – but I need your help. The GOP is going all in to defeat me, and only by building a powerful grassroots team can I fight back and win.**
[_Peter, will you add your name now to personally endorse my campaign for Senate? I’m aiming to gather 25,000 signatures before the end of the day, and it would mean a lot to have you with me in this fight._](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/mscl-endorse-cooper-0626-email/?source=email_su_pros_jtk653&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=&askdif=&t=9&akid=1726%2E124072%2EJNgqp-)

Roy Cooper

Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

**PRESIDENT TRUMP CALLS ON LOUISIANANS TO VOTE FOR JULIA LETLOW IN SENATE RUNOFF**
**BATON ROUGE, LA —** As early voting begins across Louisiana, President Donald J. Trump today called on Louisiana Republicans to support Congresswoman Julia Letlow in the U.S. Senate runoff, reaffirming his "Complete and Total Endorsement" and praising her as a "TOTAL WINNER" who will fight for the America First agenda in Washington.
In a post on Truth Social, President Trump praised Letlow's conservative record, saying “Julia has ALWAYS delivered for Louisiana, and would continue doing so in the United States Senate.” He also highlighted her leadership in Congress, and her commitment to advancing the America First agenda in the United States Senate.
"President Trump's trust and support mean the world to me," said Congresswoman Letlow. "I have been proud to stand with him from the very beginning, and I will continue fighting for the America First agenda in the United States Senate. Louisiana deserves a senator who will work alongside President Trump to secure our border, unleash American energy, strengthen our economy, support our farmers and fishermen, and protect the values that make our state and nation strong."

_I know Julia well, have seen her tested at the highest and most difficult levels, and she is a TOTAL WINNER! A Proud Mother of two children, Julia is a wonderful person, has ALWAYS delivered for Louisiana, and would continue doing so in the United States Senate. # **Jasmine Crockett suggests stabbing of Austin Metcalf was justified**
Outgoing Rep. Jasmine Crockett sparked widespread criticism after making **[a series of factually inaccurate statements](https://substack.com/redirect/7839355f-bf09-49ae-9e5a-fbeab264f75c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** about the Karmelo Anthony murder case on her podcast this week. Crockett dramatically understated the size of the knife Anthony used, suggesting it resembled a small multi-tool, when prosecutors described it as a semi-serrated blade that penetrated Metcalf's sternum and pierced his heart.

A federal judge on Friday **[rejected an emergency lawsuit seeking to block UFC Freedom 250,](https://substack.com/redirect/d94d8182-087d-4457-a43f-8f2ec9b60a65?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** a mixed martial arts event planned for the White House South Lawn and Lincoln Memorial this weekend. U.S. District Judge Amit Mehta ruled that the two Washington-area plaintiffs lacked legal standing, finding their objections -- primarily aesthetic and emotional -- did not constitute the concrete personal harm required to bring a federal case.

name: David Hogg
subject: We can be the super PAC to end all super PACs
body:
We’re fighting to end the game dark money and corporate influence have rigged for over a decade with the best tool in our arsenal: people power.
#
**Leaders We Deserve is going to be the super PAC to end all super PACs.**
_Citizens United_ has flooded our democracy with corporate cash, dark money, and special interest influence for over a decade. And the only way to fix it permanently is to elect leaders who will fight to overturn it with the urgency it demands.
But until that happens, we can’t send our candidates into races against opponents flush with unlimited corporate money, and tell them to fight with both hands behind their backs. That’s not a winning strategy.
**We play the game we have, and use the tools of a broken system to beat it in its own arena.** And we keep fighting until the system that makes this necessary no longer exists.
That’s exactly what Leaders We Deserve is doing. Backing young, bold progressive candidates who aren’t bought by special interests, who don’t have decades long loyalties to the very corporations they’re supposed to regulate, and will stand up for the working people they represent, no matter what.
And it’s your grassroots support that makes it possible — because we don’t take a dime from the special interests we’re fighting against. **Every dollar you give is proof that people power can beat big money.**

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

The NY-13 primary is less than two weeks away, and a new shell PAC just
dropped a $76,000 ad buy against Justice Democrats candidate, Darializa
Avila Chevalier.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260612-dac.8wwSMp&refcode=em20260612-37899&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1002&akid=37899%2E1203867%2E9iSomD ]Tweet from @AndrewSolender: "New possible big spender alert in #NY13: A
group called Progressive Unity Fund (registered w/ the FEC last month,
funding sources/affiliations unclear) is going up on the air w/ a $76,000
negative ad buy against Darializa Avila Chevalier, per @AdImpact_Pol"

We’re all wondering: who could be behind this? 🤔 We have a hunch...

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260612-dac.8wwSMp&refcode=em20260612-37899&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1003&akid=37899%2E1203867%2E9iSomD ]Graphic showing image of Rep. Adriano Espaillat on purple and yellow
gradient background; captioned "Endorsed Candidate Rep. Adriano Espaillat
(D-NY-13); AIPAC PAC: AIPAC is proud to stand with Pro-Israel progressive
leaders."

But they are not alone. Another brand new shell PAC is also spending to
attack Darializa, that one is called United for Progress.

That’s on top of the $2.7 million that Super PACs like BOLD PAC and BOLD
America PAC — which have a history of taking money from AIPAC and the
Crypto lobby — are already spending attacking Darializa and boosting
Espaillat.

AIPAC, the Crypto and AI lobbies, and the corporate-backed establishment
are using the same playbook in New York as they did in other 2026 primary
races like Chicago: set up a shell PAC with a vague, progressive-sounding
name, and use it to covertly funnel money to attack the most progressive
Democrat in the race. Remember AIPAC’s “Chicago Progressive Partnership”?

And it just so happens that the treasurer and address for this new group
is the same as Protect the Protectors, a pro-Cuomo front group that spent
loads against Zohran Mamdani in last year’s NYC mayoral race.

Our opponents know that Darializa is another democratic socialist surging
in the polls who threatens to bring the same bold, working-class agenda to
Congress that Zohran brought to the mayor’s office.

They will spend and do anything to maintain the status quo and keep an
ineffective, Do-Nothing Democrat in office while preventing our movement
from growing.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260612-dac.8wwSMp&refcode=em20260612-37899&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1004&akid=37899%2E1203867%2E9iSomD ]That’s why Darializa is counting on grassroots support from this
people-powered movement to help her fight back and win. Can you split
$10 to her campaign and Justice Democrats to fuel our final
sprint to the primary on June 23rd?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260612-dac.8wwSMp&refcode=em20260612-37899&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1023&akid=37899%2E1203867%2E9iSomD ]Contribute $10

Together, let’s once again prove that organized people CAN beat organized
money.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

| | Recently, Trump's own DOJ settled his lawsuit against the IRS. You've probably heard about the slush fund (of nearly $2 billion) he wanted to create from the settlement: **taxpayer-funded handouts to allies he claimed were "victims" of political persecution (which, under Trump's warped definition, almost certainly includes the January 6 insurrectionists).** Trump appears to back off the demand for this fund after getting fierce political blowback from his own party – for now. But one thing in the settlement that Trump _hasn't_ publicly backed away from? **The immunity he and his family would be granted from any IRS audit.** This is why so many Americans have lost faith in our politics. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. Friend,
There is a growing gap between what politicians in Washington say and what people here in Colorado experience every day. If things are supposedly getting better, why does it still feel harder to get ahead?
Jeff Hurd says affordability is one of his top priorities. But after nearly two years in Congress, too many families across Western and Southern Colorado are still waiting to see results.
That's why I'm running.
If you're ready for a representative who will fight every day to lower costs and put working families first, will you chip in $30 today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2606-q2-ak?;&amount=30]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

That's the difference I'll bring to Congress, and that's the campaign we're building together. If you’re with me, please consider making a contribution today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2606-q2-ak?]

Years ago, parents could lock their front doors at night and reasonably assume their children were safe from the world’s adult vices. Today, that security is an illusion. The dangers no longer wait at the doorstep; they bypass it entirely, slipping directly into our homes through the glowing screens in the palms of our children’s hands. Nowhere is this more evident than in the explosive, predatory rise of online sports betting. Since the Supreme Court cleared the way for states to legalize sports gambling in 2018, the industry has grown into a multi-billion-dollar behemoth. But in its gold rush for profit, it has found a terrifyingly lucrative new target: our kids.

Fortunately, Washington is starting to pay attention, thanks to a refreshing wave of bipartisan sanity. U.S. Senator Katie Britt (R-Ala.), alongside Senator Richard Blumenthal (D-Conn.), recently introduced the Gaming Advertisement to Minors Enforcement (GAME) Act.

U.S. Senator Katie Britt (R-Montgomery) delivered remarks Friday at the official ribbon cutting for the U.S. Coast Guard’s Enlisted Training Center of Excellence at Birmingham-Southern College, marking the culmination of months of work to bring the facility to Alabama.

Britt was joined at the ceremony by DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin, Coast Guard Commandant Admiral Kevin Lunday, U.S. Senator Tommy Tuberville (R-Auburn), U.S. Rep. Robert Aderholt (R-Haleyville), and former BSC President Daniel Coleman.

Britt discussed the latest Wednesday on Newsmax TV’s “National Report.”

clean_body: | | | | | | | Years ago, parents could lock their front doors at night and reasonably assume their children were safe from the world’s adult vices. Today, that security is an illusion. The dangers no longer wait at the doorstep; they bypass it entirely, slipping directly into our homes through the glowing screens in the palms of our children’s hands. Nowhere is this more evident than in the explosive, predatory rise of online sports betting. Since the Supreme Court cleared the way for states to legalize sports gambling in 2018, the industry has grown into a multi-billion-dollar behemoth. But in its gold rush for profit, it has found a terrifyingly lucrative new target: our kids. Fortunately, Washington is starting to pay attention, thanks to a refreshing wave of bipartisan sanity. U.S. Senator Katie Britt (R-Ala.), alongside Senator Richard Blumenthal (D-Conn.), recently introduced the Gaming Advertisement to Minors Enforcement (GAME) Act. | | U.S. Senator Katie Britt (R-Montgomery) delivered remarks Friday at the official ribbon cutting for the U.S. Coast Guard’s Enlisted Training Center of Excellence at Birmingham-Southern College, marking the culmination of months of work to bring the facility to Alabama. Britt was joined at the ceremony by DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin, Coast Guard Commandant Admiral Kevin Lunday, U.S. Senator Tommy Tuberville (R-Auburn), U.S. Rep. Robert Aderholt (R-Haleyville), and former BSC President Daniel Coleman. | | U.S. Sen. Katie Britt (R-Montgomery) condemned many of her colleagues on the other side of the aisle for not supporting the continuing conflict against the terrorist regime in Iran. President Donald Trump ordered new military strikes against the Iranian regime this week after a drone fired by Tehran hit a U.S. Apache helicopter. Many Democrats have criticized the ongoing effort, calling on the President to end the war immediately. Britt discussed the latest Wednesday on Newsmax TV’s “National Report.” | | | | | | | I didn’t run for Senate to sit on the sidelines. I’m a mom, a conservative, and proud to stand for every corner of Alabama—our cities, small towns, and rural communities alike. I’m rooted in faith, built on family, and committed to making Alabama stronger and better for generations to come. Alabama is a place of hard work, strong values, and unyielding independence. But the Left is trying to tear that all down. I didn’t come to Washington to play games. I came to fight for every Alabamian who feels forgotten and left behind. Whether it’s securing our borders, protecting our children, or defending our way of life, I’m here fighting for Alabama’s future. This fight isn’t easy, but it's worth it. And I’m not going anywhere. clean_body: | I’m livid, Peter. Yesterday, Trump’s federal agents raided the offices and homes of those affiliated with the Ohio Organizing Collaborative, an organization dedicated to defending democracy and voting rights in Ohio. There’s no two ways about this: Donald Trump is seeking to limit access to the ballot by intimidating those of us who fight to preserve our constitutional right to democracy. The Ohio Organizing Collaborative exists because of activity like this; because Republicans have purged voter rolls and redrawn ludicrous districts to weaken the power of Black voters in Ohio. Trump cannot intimidate us. He’s doing this because he’s losing, and we need to send a clear message: your losing streak is just getting started. We’re not giving up. We will not go silently. – Emily Randall | | Emily Randall is proud to represent Washington’s 6th District in Congress. She grew up in a working-class Union household in Port Orchard and was the first in her family to attend college. subject: Here’s what Greg Abbott forgot to mention:
body:
Greg Abbott just gave a speech in Houston today
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Greg Abbott just gave a speech in Houston today at the Texas GOP Convention, Peter.
He had a lot to say to his Republican base — but here’s what he forgot to mention:
❌ He forgot to mention that schools are closing across our state because he is funneling taxpayer dollars into his school voucher scheme
❌ He's flip-flopped on data centers, despite helping create the most generous tax giveaway to those companies
❌ He said he would ban H-1B visas after spending years facilitating them to enrich his biggest donors
Peter, Greg Abbott isn’t fighting for us — he’s fighting for his billionaire donors.
That’s his record. Hypocrisy. Corruption. And his agenda consistently leaves working families behind.
I’m running for governor because Texans deserve better.
As governor, I will strengthen our public schools, hold down utility costs for working families, and make sure every Texas child can get the healthcare they need. I will work for the people of Texas, not billionaire donors and political insiders.
Greg Abbott’s speech was based on lies and his and his friends’ blind idea of what Texas stands for — but we know the truth, and voters are ready to kick him out this fall.

# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=240900%2E444211%2ESTYvtn)
If you move in Texas — across the street, across town — you have to manually re-register to vote. Every single time.
To fight back against this voter suppression, we've identified 440,000 Texans who have recently moved and are likely Democratic voters — who may not know they need to re-register.
Our partners mailed voter registration forms to 150,000 Texans who have recently moved — 50,000 from out of state, 100,000 from within Texas.
But we know that sending a single mailer isn't enough. So Powered by People is running the chase, meaning we’ll connect with every single one of these Texans.
We’re a few days into our voter chase program for these Texans and **we wanted to pull back the curtain and give you a behind the scenes look at where we’re at:**
**The Numbers:**
We are just at the beginning of our outreach to the Texans who have recently moved, and these first few days are all about laying the foundation for the massive chase program to come. Here is a look at the early data from our initial outreach waves:
* **Wave 1 Texts (June 4):** Sent to ~112k voters to kick off the program. Over 1,100 engaged back, and 115 asked to have a dedicated voter buddy stay in touch with them (powered by an initial group of 12 volunteers)
* **Wave 1 Calls (June 9):** Dialed ~3,500 voters in just one hour with a dedicated team of 22 staff members, adding 20 more to our voter database. Note: We have volunteer phone banks scheduled this weekend to significantly expand this reach and close the gap.
* **Wave 2 Texts (June 10):** Followed up with ~107k voters who hadn’t replied to us yet. So far, ~1,000 have engaged back, and 120 were added to our organizing database for us to keep in contact with (with 25 volunteers).

**Key Takeaway:**
**Once a live text conversation is established, voter willingness to stay in touch with us for ongoing follow-up is consistent.** Every conversation started represents a voter who won’t be left behind as we scale up our operations in the weeks ahead.
**This work is only possible because of people like you chipping in when they can. We'll need to raise $66,000 to cover the texts, calls, and contact data needed to reach all of these Texans.**
[**Can you help us cover these costs? Please donate $3 right now to ensure we have the resources to contact these voters and get them registered to vote.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260612.wY88M3&refcode=ema20260612-240900&t=3&akid=240900%2E444211%2ESTYvtn)

Thank you for your support,

Peter, it’s Adam Schiff with an urgent message.
Lieutenant Colonel (Ret.) Alex Vindman is running for the U.S. Senate in Florida, and the latest polls show him with a real path to victory. If he wins, then Democrats are virtually guaranteed to take back the Senate majority.
The stakes in this race couldn’t be higher. That’s why I am doing everything I can to help elect Alex, but I need you to join me.
[**Will you please make a donation of $3 to Alex Vindman’s campaign today? Do it before his critical FEC deadline >>**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avvf-digi-em-q22026?refcode=em260612-2&amount=3&refcode2=701_3892029_ppeq08&akid=701%2E3892029%2Eppeq08)
**[DONATE](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avvf-digi-em-q22026?refcode=em260612-2&refcode2=701_3892029_ppeq08&akid=701%2E3892029%2Eppeq08)**
Alex Vindman exemplifies courage and leadership. He defended our nation in the U.S. Army, and he stood up for our democracy when he testified before Congress during the first impeachment of Donald Trump.
On July 25, 2019, Alex witnessed a telephone call between President Donald Trump and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, during which Trump pressured President Zelenskyy to announce an investigation into then-former Vice President Joe Biden in order to continue receiving United States military aid.
You might remember when Alex bravely testified before Congress that he could speak out against the most powerful man in the world because “ _here, right matters._ ”
I still believe that, and Alex and I worked together to shed light on a blatant abuse of power by the President of the United States. **Now, Alex is running for U.S. Senate in Florida to continue the fight for our democracy.**
Democrats have delivered statewide wins and razor-thin margins in Florida in recent years. That means that, with enough resources, Alex has a real shot at winning this race and flipping this Senate seat blue.
After the work we did together in Trump’s first impeachment, Alex and I were the target of constant MAGA attacks. This race is no different. The momentum is on our side to win back the Senate for Democrats this November, but it will only be possible if we’re in it together.
[**Will you make a contribution to Alex Vindman and help us push Democrats to victory everywhere?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avvf-digi-em-q22026?refcode=em260612-2&refcode2=701_3892029_ppeq08&akid=701%2E3892029%2Eppeq08)

body:
https://elfrethformaryland.com/ [https://elfrethformaryland.com/]
Friend,

If you’ve turned on the news, you probably saw the massive 92-foot-tall cage taking over the White House lawn for the "UFC Freedom 250" matches.

Well, let’s be completely honest: I’m not tuning into a cage match at the White House.

But now that I have your attention, let me introduce you to a few leaders at the state and local level who you should focus on instead:

Vanessa Atterbeary [https://www.vanessaatterbeary.org/] , running for Howard County Executive, is a Howard County native, mother, and an accomplished legislator I’ve worked with to tackle issues, like ending Child Marriage in Maryland.

Allison Pickard [https://www.allisonpickard.com/] , running for Anne Arundel County Executive, is a tireless public servant and dedicated mom who has spent her career fighting for stronger public schools, safer neighborhoods, and responsible local governance.

Adrian Boafo [https://www.adrianboafo.com/] , running for Maryland’s Fifth Congressional District, is a son of immigrants and a dedicated community advocate who knows firsthand the challenges working families face in navigating housing, education, and economic opportunity.

Donate ➔ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/SEMD-03-Email-June2026-FR-TrumpUFC?&refcode=E30022-20260612-TrumpUFC-SB-2026Race&amount=15]

While the cameras are fixed on Washington, our campaign is keeping our boots on the ground, running through the tape, and staying laser-focused on early voting and primary day mobilization. Real leadership isn't about capturing cable news headlines or staging media stunts; it's about having the practical dedication to fight for working families right here in our district.

On Friday morning over 600 hundred Louisianans showed up to the Louisiana state capitol to protest and speak out against a new Congressional map proposed by the Louisiana GOP that will erase Louisiana's two black majority districts and establish all white districts.
During the hearing on redistricting, GOP State Senator Jay Morris yelled "Shut up, boy" to my Executive Director Dadrius Lanus, a Black man, who, in Sen. Morris’s words was “commenting and talking” too loudly for him to concentrate.
Sir, I am a 70 year old Black man and we know what it means to be called “Boy.”
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-louisianadems [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-louisianadems]
Senator Morris says we misheard. That the audio proves it. That he said “you all need to shut up” to the Black constituents behind him outraged that their votes won't be counted.
Senator Morris, an elected member of our legislature, thinks if he had yelled “you all need to shut up” it would be better.
It wouldn't.
What Senator Morris doesn’t understand is that White people have been telling Black folk to “shut up" for over 250 years.
What Senator Morris doesn’t understand is that we remember being told we were 3/5ths of a person. That even when we won personhood in the eyes of the law, they instituted poll taxes and “reading” tests. That when we marched and dreamed and cried and buried loved ones who had hung as strange fruit from tall trees because they raised their voices too loud that what Black people have always wanted is equality.
Or maybe Senator Morris does understand all that.
I don’t know.
What I do know is that I am a 70 year old Black man. And I don’t let anyone call me or my brothers “Boy.”
Please, chip in $10 or more today split between the Louisiana Democrats and Resist Reclaim Rebuild. Let’s show them that they may have gutted the Voting Rights Act and canceled our election, but we will not be silenced. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-louisianadems]
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie]

Thank you for coming to Louisiana’s aid in our time of crisis.

Hey, it’s Attorney General Kris Mayes here — I’ll say it plain and simple: **I’m not letting an “Election Integrity Army” prevent Arizonans from casting their votes.** Recently, Trump took to Truth Social to announce that Republicans would deploy an “Election Integrity Army” in every single state ahead of this year’s midterms. Let me tell you what that actually means: ❌ Trained operatives showing up to polling places to intimidate voters
❌ Baseless legal challenges designed to throw out legitimate ballots
❌ Trump’s DOJ demanding voter rolls and election data from states, including Arizona It is a coordinated, top-down effort to tilt the 2026 elections in Republicans’ favor. Here’s my message to Donald Trump: **Arizona is not yours to intimidate.** As Arizona’s Attorney General, I’ve fought this administration’s efforts to delegitimize our elections and strip Arizonans of their voter rights at every turn. clean_body: How could anyone who served slam our own troops like that? | We were absolutely appalled when we heard this. We owe our freedom, our safety, and our very way of life to the brave men and women who fought for us at home and overseas. That is why it is absolutely disgraceful that Maine's presumptive Democratic nominee would stoop so low as to attack our service members. How could anyone who served slam our own troops like that? Our military members sacrifice everything to keep us safe. They deserve our utmost respect, not vile insults from a political candidate. But he does not care. He will not apologize or stand up for his actions. He sleeps soundly knowing that millions are being poured into Maine to support him. We cannot let them get away with this. We need a leader in the Senate who will fiercely defend our military, not insult them. Senator Collins has always fought to ensure our armed forces have the resources and respect they deserve, but she cannot win this battle alone. name: Xavier Becerra
subject: Our fight to defend California from MAGA extremism starts now
body:
**BREAKING, Peter: Republican Steve Hilton is our opponent in the general election for California Governor!**
We’re entering a new stage in our fight, and we cannot afford to slow down. I can’t win the general election against a Trump loyalist on my own.
So I am asking you directly:
**[Will you please split a $5 contribution between my campaign for California governor and Wes Moore today? Your donation, no matter how big or small, will help us ensure a Democrat sits in the governor’s office next January.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260612-2.IZVrK7&refcode=em-20260612-2&t=1&akid=1491%2E1086043%2ElMR5VH)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260612-2.IZVrK7&amount=5&refcode=em-20260612-2&t=20&akid=1491%2E1086043%2ElMR5VH)**
My parents, Manuel and Maria, came to this country with $12 in their pockets. That’s it. $12 to build a life for my family. I was born and raised in Sacramento, where they taught my siblings and me the value of hard work.
My father worked in construction. My mother worked clerical jobs. It wasn’t easy. But they worked hard and saved every penny they could to provide a better life for their children.
Despite those humble beginnings, they were able to own a home, send the four of us kids to college or the military, and set aside enough to retire with dignity.
**To me, that’s the California Dream – and that’s what I’m fighting to defend in this race for California governor.**
Because today, despite having the largest economy in the country, that dream of owning a home, raising a family, and retiring with dignity is all too hard for Californians to attain. That’s why I’m promising to build our state’s economy, create opportunities and lower costs for working families, and protect the California we all love. And it’s why I am in this fight.
But the second half of this race will be no easy feat.
We’re officially up against Trump’s handpicked MAGA lackey, Steve Hilton. He’s going to have the might of the MAGA machine behind him and millions at his disposal to tear down our grassroots movement.
We need to be ready for anything that comes our way and keep California out of MAGA's hands. So I am asking personally:
**[Will you please contribute $5 to my campaign today and Wes Moore to help us start the general election off strong and beat my MAGA opponent? My campaign relies on folks like you giving what they can, when they can.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260612-2.IZVrK7&refcode=em-20260612-2&t=21&akid=1491%2E1086043%2ElMR5VH)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260612-2.IZVrK7&amount=5&refcode=em-20260612-2&t=40&akid=1491%2E1086043%2ElMR5VH)**
Let’s win this race — together.
Xavier Becerra
[](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260612-2.IZVrK7&refcode=em-20260612-2&t=41&akid=1491%2E1086043%2ElMR5VH)

* * *
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a critical way we communicate with grassroots supporters like you. However, if you would like to change your subscription preferences, here are some options:
* [Receive Fewer Emails](https://act.wesmoore.com/signup/receive-fewer-emails/?t=42&akid=1491%2E1086043%2ElMR5VH)
* [Update Your Information](https://act.wesmoore.com/signup/update-your-information/)
* [Unsubscribe](https://act.wesmoore.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=43&akid=1491%2E1086043%2ElMR5VH)

Email us: [info@wesmoore.com](mailto:info@wesmoore.com)
BY AUTHORITY: WES MOORE FOR MARYLAND, MARY TYDINGS, TREASURER

name: Adem T. Bunkeddeko
subject: This not the end
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Adem for New York
body:
logo [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104353/images/atb-logo%402x.png]
Peter,
After much reflection, I’ve decided to suspend our efforts to continue pursuing ballot access in the June 23 Democratic Primary.
This was not an easy decision.
Over the past several weeks, our campaign has been consumed by litigation and procedural fights that required extraordinary time, attention, and resources that otherwise would have been spent doing what campaigns should do: speaking with voters and making our case for New York’s future.
During this campaign, I also experienced the loss of my father. That experience reminded me that time is precious, and that public service must always remain grounded in family, community, and purpose.
Despite these challenges, I could not be prouder of what we built together.
In a short period of time, we built a grassroots campaign rooted in the belief that public money should build public prosperity and that New York can be more affordable, more accountable, and more ambitious.
Thank you to every volunteer, supporter, donor, and New Yorker who gave their time, energy, and trust to this campaign.
The values that brought us together do not end here.
This is not the end of the work. It is simply the end of this chapter.
With Gratitude,
Adem

Adem for New York
P.O. Box 130-427,
Brooklyn, NY 11213
